title: A bill to authorize the Secretary of State to prescribe the fee for execution of an application for a passport and to continue to transfer to the U.S. Postal Service the execution fee for each application accepted by that Service.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of State to prescribe the fee for execution of an application for a passport.

title: An Act authorizing the President to proclaim the period of September 15, 1974 through October 15, 1974, as "Johnny Horizon '76 Clean Up America Month".
summary: Authorizes the President to proclaim the period of September 15, 1974 through October 15, 1974, as "Johnny Horizon '76' Clean Up America Month".

title: An Act to amend title 37, United States Code, to refine the procedures for adjustments in military compensation, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides for procedures for upward adjustments in regular military compensation.

title: A bill to amend the Act of October 13, 1972.
summary: Provides that the Commission on Revision of the Federal Court Appellate System shall submit its report on the structure and internal procedures of the Federal Court System within twenty-four months (formerly fifteen months) from the date on which its ninth member is appointed.

title: A bill to authorize Federal agricultural assistance to Guam for certain purposes.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of Agriculture to provide financial and technical assistance to Guam for improving fire control, watershed protection and reforestation.

title: Alcohol and Drug Abuse Education Act Amendments of 1974
An Act to amend the Public Works and Economic Development Act of 1965 to extend the authorizations for a 2-year period, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes appropriations for fiscal years 1975 and 1976 to programs under the Public Works and Economic Assistance Act.

title: Joint resolution asking the President of the United States to declare the fourth Saturday of September, 1974 "National Hunting and Fishing Day".
summary: Authorizes the President of the United States to declare the fourth Saturday of September 1974 as "National Hunting and Fishing Day".

title: Joint resolution to extend termination date of Export-Import Bank.
summary: Provides for a fifteen-day extension of the expiration date of the Export-Import Bank Act of 1945, from September 30 to October 15, 1974.

title: Defense Production Act Amendments of 1974
summary: Repeals the provisions of the Defense Production Act of 1950 authorizing loans to private business for defense purposes and loans to private business and government agencies for the purchase of raw materials and installation of equipment.

title: A bill to amend the act of October 27, 1972 (Public Law 92-578).
summary: Provides the Pennsylvania Avenue Development Corporation with authority to procure the temporary services of city planners, architects, engineers and other experts.

title: Egg Research and Consumer Information Act
A bill to designate certain lands in the Okefenokee National Wildlife Refuge, Ga., as wilderness.
summary: Designates specified lands comprising approximately 343,850 acres of the Okefenokee National Wildlife Refuge, Georgia, as wilderness.

title: A bill to authorize appropriations for the Coast Guard for the procurement of vessels and aircraft and construction of shore and offshore establishments, to authorize appropriations for bridge alterations, to authorize for the Coast Guard an end-year strength for active duty personnel, to authorize for the Coast Guard average military student loads, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorize appropriations for the Coast Guard: for the procurement of vessels ($22,676,000), aircraft ($17,793,000), construction of shore and offshore establishments ($74,731,000), and bridge alterations ($6,800,000).

title: Boston National Historical Park Act of 1974
A bill to authorize the conveyance to the city of Salem, Ill., of a statue of William Jennings Bryan.
summary: Provides for the donation by the Secretary of the Interior of a statue of William Jennings Bryan from the Department of the Interior to the City of Salem, Illinois.

title: Departments of State, Justice, and Commerce, the Judiciary, and Related Agencies Appropriation Act, 1975
summary: Makes appropriations for the Department of Justice and related agencies for the fiscal year 1975.

title: A bill to amend the Emergency Daylight Saving Time Energy Conservation Act of 1973 to exempt from its provisions the period from the last Sunday in October 1974, through the last Sunday in February 1975.
summary: Provides that during the period from the last Sunday in October, 1974, through the last Sunday in February, 1975 the provisions of the Emergency Daylight Saving Time Energy Conservation Act shall not be applicable.

title: A bill to place certain submerged lands within the jurisdiction of the governments of Guam, the Virgin Islands, and American Samoa, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the conveyance by the United States of specified submerged lands to the governments of Guam, the Virgin Islands, and American Somoa.

title: A bill to extend the appropriation authorization for reporting of weather modification activities.
summary: Extends the appropriation authorization through fiscal year 1977 for reporting of weather modification activities.

title: Department of Defense Appropriation Act, 1975
summary: Makes appropriations for the Department of Defense for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1975.

title: Energy Reorganization Act of 1974
summary: Establishes the Energy Research and Development Administration headed by an Administrator appointed by the President.

title: A bill to authorize the establishment of the Big Thicket National Preserve in the State of Texas, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the establishment of the Big Thicket National Preserve in the State of Texas.

title: A bill to establish the Big Cypress National Preserve in the State of Florida, and for other purposes.
summary: Establishes the Big Cypress National Preserve in the State of Florida.

title: A bill to authorize the Secretary of the Treasury to change the alloy and weight of the 1-cent piece and to amend the Bank Holding Act Amendments of 1970 to authorize grants to Eisenhower College, Seneca Falls, New York.
summary: States that the Secretary of the Treasury may change the composition of the copper-zinc alloy used in minting the one-cent piece whenever he deems such action to be appropriate to asure an adequate supply of coins to meet the national needs.

title: Joint resolution authorizing the President to proclaim the second full week in October, 1974, as "National Legal Secretaries' Court Observance Week".
summary: Authorizes the President to proclaim the second full week in October each year as "National Legal Secretaries' Court Observance Week".

title: Federal Election Campaign Act Amendments of 1974

An Act to amend the act of October 4, 1961, providing for the preservation and protection of certain lands known as Piscataway Park in Prince Georges and Charles Counties, Maryland, and for other purposes.
summary: Redefines the boundaries of the lands known as Piscataway Park in Prince Georges and Charles Counties, Maryland.

title: Railroad Retirement Act of 1974
Joint resolution authorizing the procurement of an oil portrait and marble bust of former Chief Justice Earl Warren.
summary: Authorizes the procurement of an oil portrait and marble bust of former Chief Justice Earl Warren to be placed in the United State Supreme Court Building.

title: A bill to redesignate the Alamogordo Dam and Reservoir, New Mexico, as Sumner Dam and Lake Sumner, respectively.
summary: Redesignates the Alamogordo Dam and Reservoir, New Mexico, as the Sumner Dam and Lake Sumner, respectively.

title: Joint resolution making further continuing appropriations for the fiscal year 1975, and for other purposes.
summary: Revises the Continuing Appropriation Act, 1975, to extend the continuing appropriations for the fiscal year 1975 to the sine die adjournment of the 93rd Congress for the various departments, agencies, corporations and other organizational units of the Government.

title: Emergency Home Purchase Assistance Act of 1974
Joint resolution to extend the authority of the Export-Import Bank of the United States.
summary: Provides for an extension of the expiration date of the Export-Import Bank Act of 1945, from October 15 to November 30, 1974.

title: A bill to declare that the US holds in trust for the Bridgeport Indian Colony certain lands in Mono County, California.
summary: Declares that the United States holds in trust for the Bridgeport Indian Colony specified lands in Mono County, California.

title: A bill to extend and expand the authority for carrying out conservation and rehabilitation programs on military reservations, and to authorize the implementation of such programs on certain public lands.
A bill to authorize the conveyance of certain lands to the New Mexico State University, Las Cruces, N. Mex..
summary: Authorizes the conveyance of specified public lands to the New Mexico State University, Las Cruces, New Mexico.

title: Federal Columbia River Transmission System Act

An Act to amend the Military Personnel and Civilian Employees' Claims Act of 1964, as amended, with respect to the settlement of claims against the United States by members of the uniformed services and civilian officers and employees for damage to, or loss of, personal property incident to their service.
summary: Increases the maximum amount receivable to $15,000 for the settlement of claims against the United States by military personnel and civilian employees for damage to, or loss of, personal property incident to their service, under the Military Personnel and Civilian Employees' Claims Act of 1964.

title: A bill to direct the Secretary of Agriculture to release on behalf of the U.S. conditions in a deed conveying certain lands to the State of New York and to provide for the conveyance of certain interests in such lands so as to permit such State, subject to certain conditions, to sell such land.
A bill to amend the act entitled "An Act to authorize the Secretary of Agriculture to execute a subordination agreement with respect to certain lands in Lee County, S.C.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior and the Secretary of Agriculture to execute a quitclaim deed releasing specified lands in Lee County, South Carolina.

title: An Act to declare that certain federally owned lands shall be held by the United States in trust for the Kootenai Tribe of Idaho, and for other purposes.
summary: Declares that specified, federally owned lands shall be held by the United States in trust for the Kootenai Tribe of Idaho.

title: A bill to amend section 308 of title 44, United States Code, relating to the disbursing officer, deputy disbursing officer, and certifying officers and employees of the Government Printing Office.
summary: Authorizes the Public Printer to appoint from time to time a disbursing officer of the Government Printing Office who shall be under the direction of the Public Printer.

title: A bill to amend the International Claims Settlement Act of 1949, as amended, to provide for the timely determination of certain claims of American nationals settled by the United States-Hungarian Claims Agreement of March 6, 1973, and for other purposes.
summary: Requires the Secretary of the Treasury to cover into the Hungarian Claims Fund such sums as may be paid to the United States by the Government of Hungary pursuant to the terms of the United States-Hungarian Claims Agreement of March 6, 1973.

title: A bill to repeal the "cooly trade" laws.
An Act to authorize the disposition of certain office equipment and furnishings, and for other purposes.
Commodity Futures Trading Commission Act of 1974
summary: Establishes a Commodity Futures Trading Commission to be composed of five Commissioners appointed by the President, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate.

title: A bill to provide for emergency allotment lease and transfer of tobacco allotments or quotas for 1974 in certain disaster areas in North Carolina.
summary: Permits the emergency allotment lease and transfer of tobacco allotments or quotas for 1974 in disaster areas in Craven, Carteret, and Jones counties in North Carolina.

title: A bill to amend the Canal Zone Code to transfer the functions of the Clerk of the U.S. District Court for the District of the Canal Zone with respect to the issuance and recording of marriage licenses, and related activities, to the civil affairs director of the Canal Zone Government, and for other purposes.
summary: Transfers, under the Canal Zone Code, functions of the Clerk of the United States District Court for the District of the Canal Zone with respect to the issuance and recording of marriage licenses to the Governor of the Canal Zone.

title: An Act to amend the act of June 30, 1944, an act "To provide for the establishment of the Harpers Ferry National Monument", and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior, for the purpose of the development of the Harpers Ferry National Historical Park, to acquire lands or interests in lands by donation, purchase with donated or appropriated funds, or exchange within the boundaries of the map specified in this Act.

title: An Act granting the consent of Congress to the Cumbres and Toltec Scenic Railroad Compact.
summary: Grants the consent of Congress to the Cumbres and Toltec Scenic Railroad Compact, as agreed to by the States of Colorado and New Mexico.

title: A bill to increase the limit on dues for U.S. membership in the International Criminal Police Organization.
summary: Increases, from $80,000 to $120,000, the limit on dues for United States membership in the International Criminal Police Organization.

title: A bill to extend the time limit for the award of certain military decorations.
summary: Extends the time limit for the awarding of military decorations or devices in lieu of a decoration which have been authorized by Congress to be awarded for an act or service performed in direct support of military operations in Southeast Asia.

title: An Act to suspend the duty on synthetic rutile until the close of June 30, 1977.
summary: Suspends the existing duty on synthetic rutile until the close of June 30, 1977.

title: District of Columbia Public Postsecondary Education Reorganization Act
summary: States that it is the intent of Congress to authorize a public land-grant university through the reorganization of the existing local institutions of public post-secondary education in the District of Columbia.

title: An Act to extend for one year the authorization for appropriations to implement title I of the Marine Protection, Research, and Sanctuaries Act of 1972.
summary: Extends for one year the authorization for appropriations to implement title I of the Marine Protection, Research, and Santuaries Act of 1972.

title: Solar Energy Research, Development, and Demonstration Act of 1974
summary: Expresses the findings of Congress and declares that it is the policy of the United States to pursue a vigorous and adequately funded program with the objective of utilizing solar energy as a major source for our national energy needs.

title: A bill to amend chapter 83 of title 5, United States Code, to eliminate the annuity reduction made, in order to provide a surviving spouse with an annuity, during periods when the annuitant is not married.
summary: Revises the present procedures for payment of retirement annuities to Federal employees.

title: State Department/USIA Authorization Act, Fiscal Year 1975
summary: Authorizes appropriations for the State Department and the United States Information Agency for fiscal year 1975.

title: A joint resolution to provide for the indemnification of the Metropolitan Museum of New York for loss or damage suffered by objects in exhibition in the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.
summary: Provides for the indemnification of the Metropolitan Museum of New York for loss or damage suffered by objects in exhibition in the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.

title: An Act to provide for increases in appropriation ceilings and boundary changes in certain units of the National Park System, to authorize appropriations for additional costs of land acquisition for the National Park System, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the National Visitor Center Facilities Act of 1968.
summary: Provides, under the National Visitor Center Act, that the Union Station Building may be leased by the United States at a time agreed upon by the parties, and not necessarily when the building is ready for public use.

title: Foreign Investment Study Act of 1974
summary: Directs the Secretary of the Treasury and the Secretary of Commerce to conduct a comprehensive, overall study of foreign direct and portfolio investments in the United States.

title: An Act to correct an anomaly in the rate of duty applicable to crude feathers and downs, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides for the duty free treatment of feathers and downs imported into the United States on or before December 31, 1976.

title: An Act to amend the Controlled Substances Act to extend for three fiscal years the authorizations of appropriations for the administration and enforcement of that Act.
An Act to amend the Tariff Schedules of the United States to provide for the duty-free entry of methanol imported for use as fuel, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides for the import duty-free status of methyl alcohol (methanol) when imported for use in producing synthetic natural gas or for direct use as a fuel.

title: An Act to suspend until the close of June 30, 1975, the duty on certain carboxymethyl cellulose salts, and for other purposes.
summary: Suspends until the close of June 30, 1975, the duty on specified carboxymethyl cellulose sodium salts.

title: An Act to suspend for a temporary period the import duty on certain horses, and for other purposes.
summary: Suspends until June 30, 1976, the import duty under the Tariff Schedules on horses, other than for immediate slaughter.

title: A bill to amend the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended, to enable Congress to concur in or disapprove international agreements for cooperation in regard to certain nuclear technology.
summary: Authorizes Congress under the Atomic Energy Act, to concur in or disapprove international agreements for cooperation in regard to certain nuclear technology.

title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Clara Barton National Historic Site, Maryland; John Day Fossil Beds National Monument, Oregon; Knife River Indian Villages National Historic Site, North Dakota; Springfield Armory National Historic Site, Massachusetts; Tuskegee Institute National Historic Site, Alabama; Martin Van Buren National Historic Site, New York; and Sewall-Belmont House National Historic Site, Washington, District of Columbia; and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the Intercoastal Shipping Act, 1933.
summary: Revises the Intercoastal Shipping Act of 1933 by providing that the Act shall apply to the carriage, storage or handling of property for the United States, State or municipal governments, or for charitable purposes.

title: An Act to extend the Regional Rail Reorganization Act's reporting date, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides for an extension of one hundred and twenty days for the United States Railway Association to adopt a preliminary system plan and one hundred and twenty days to prepare a final system plan under the provisions of the Regional Rail Reorganization Act.

title: A bill to declare that certain federally owned lands are held by the United States in trust for the Sisseton-Wahpeton Sioux Tribe of the Lake Traverse Indian Reservation in North and South Dakota.
summary: Declares that specified federally owned lands are held by the United States in trust for the Sisseton-Wahpeton Sioux Tribe of the Lake Traverse Indian Reservation in North and South Dakota.

title: An Act to suspend the duties of certain bicycle parts and accessories until the close of December 31, 1976, and for other purposes.
summary: Suspends the import duties on specified bicycle parts and accessories until the close of December 31, 1976, under the Tariff Schedules of the United States.

title: An Act to authorize the Sisseton and Wahpeton Sioux Tribe of the Lake Traverse Reservation to consolidate its landholdings in North Dakota and South Dakota, and for other purposes.
Motor Vehicle and Schoolbus Safety Amendments of 1974
summary: Authorizes to be appropriated, to carry out the National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act of 1966, $55,000,000 and $60,000,000 for fiscal years 1975 and 1976, respectively.

title: An Act to authorize, enlarge, and repair various Federal Reclamation projects and programs, and for other purposes.
summary: States that the purpose of this title is to separate the town of Page, Arizona, from the Colorado River storage project so that the United States may withdraw from ownership and operation of the town, and the town may be incorporated and self-governing.

title: A bill to authorize appropriations for the Indian Claims Commission for fiscal year 1975.
summary: Authorizes appropriations for the Indian Claims Commission for fiscal year 1975.

title: An Act to increase deposit insurance from $20,000 to $40,000, to provide full insurance for public unit deposits of $100,000 per account, to establish a National Commission on Electronic Fund Transfers, and for other purposes.
Amtrak Improvement Act of 1974
summary: Provides that the National Railroad Passenger Corporation shall directly perform all maintenance, rehabilitation, repair, and refurbishment of rail passenger equipment.

title: An Act to continue until the close of June 30, 1975, the suspension of duties on certain forms of copper, and for other purposes.
summary: Extends until the close of June 30, 1975, the suspension of import duties on various forms of copper.

title: Federal Fire Prevention and Control Act of 1974
summary: Establishes in the Department of Commerce the National Fire Prevention and Control Administration.

title: An Act to extend for an additional temporary period the existing suspension of duties on certain classifications of yarns of silk, and for other purposes.
summary: Extends for an additional temporary 2 year period the existing suspension of duties on various classifications of yearns of silk under the Tariff Schedules of the United States.

title: Export Administration Amendments of 1974
summary: Removes the requirement that foreign demand be "abnormal" before export controls may be imposed.

title: An Act to authorize the regulation of interest rates payable on obligations issued by affiliates of certain depository institutions, and for other purposes.
summary: Revises the Federal Reserve Act by authorizing the Federal Reserve Board to regulate debt obligations of a parent holding company or an affiliate of a member bank regardless of the use of the proceeds within the holding company.

title: A bill to amend section 552 of title 5, United States Code, known as the Freedom of Information Act.
National Mass Transportation Assistance Act of 1974
summary: Increases, under the Urban Mass Transportation Act, the total amount of obligations which the Secretary of Transportation may incur to finance specified grants and loans to $10,925,000,000.

title: A bill to eliminate discrimination based on sex in the youth programs offered by the Naval Sea Cadet Corps.
summary: Provides for the elimination of discrimination based on sex in the youth programs offered by the Naval Sea Cadet Corps.

title: A bill to amend the Communications Act of 1934, as amended, to permit the Federal Communications Commission to grant radio station licenses in the safety and special and experimental radio services directly to aliens, representatives of aliens, foreign corporations, or domestic corporations with alien officers, directors, or stockholders; and to permit aliens holding such radio station licenses to be licensed as operators.
summary: Permits the Federal Communications Commission to grant radio station licenses in the safety and special and experimental radio services directly to aliens, representatives of aliens, foreign corporations, or domestic corporations with alien officers, directors, or stockholders.

title: A bill to amend subsection (b) of section 214 and subsection (c)(1) of section 222 of the Communications Act of 1934, as amended, in order to designate the Secretary of Defense (rather than the Secretaries of the Army and the Navy) as the person entitled to receive official notice of the filing of certain applications in the common carrier service and to provide notice to the Secretary of State where under section 214 applications involve service to foreign points.

A bill to amend section 415 of the Communications Act of 1934, as amended, to provide for a two-year period of limitations in proceedings against carriers for the recovery of overcharges or damages not based on overcharges.
summary: Provides that all actions at law by carriers for recovery of their lawful charges, or any part thereof, shall be begun, within two years from the time the cause of action accrues, and not after such date.

title: An Act to amend title 38, United States Code, to increase vocational rehabilitation subsistence allowances, educational and training assistance allowances, and special allowances paid to eligible veterans and persons under chapters 31, 34, and 35 of such title; to improve and expand the special programs for educationally disadvantaged veterans and servicemen under chapter 34 of such title; to improve and expand the veteran student services program; to establish an education loan program for veterans and persons eligible for benefits under chapter 34 or 35 of such title; to make other improvements in the educational assistance program and in the administration of educational benefits; to promote the employment of veterans and the wives and widows of certain veterans by improving and expanding the provisions governing the operation of the Veterans Employment Service, by increasing the employment of veterans by Federal contractors and subcontractors, and by providing for an action plan for the employment of disabled and Vietnam era veterans within the Federal Government; to codify and expand veterans reemployment rights; and for other purposes.
summary: Increases the rates of educational assistance payable to veterans.

title: National Wildlife Refuge System Administration Act Amendments of 1974
summary: Requires the payment of the fair market value of rights-of-way or other interests granted in wildlife refuges by the Secretary of the Interior.

title: Joint Funding Simplification Act of 1974
A bill to extend the Emergency Petroleum Allocation Act of 1973 until August 31, 1975.
summary: Extends the Emergency Petroleum Allocation Act of 1973 until August 31, 1975.

title: A bill to improve judicial machinery by amending title 28, United States Code, to broaden and clarify the grounds for judicial disqualification.
A joint resolution assuring compensation for damages caused by nuclear incidents involving the nuclear reactor of a U.S. warship.
A bill to provide available nuclear information to Committees and Members of Congress.
summary: Provides, under the Atomic Energy Act, that the members of the Joint Committee on Atomic Energy shall, on or before June 30th of each year, report to their respective House on the development, use, and control of nuclear energy for the common defense and security and for peaceful purposes.

title: An Act to authorize the District of Columbia to enter into the Interstate Agreement on Qualification of Educational Personnel, and to amend the Practice of Psychology Act and the District of Columbia Unemployment Compensation Act.
summary: Authorizes the Commissioner of the District of Columbia to enter into, and execute on behalf of the District of Columbia, the Interstate Agreement on Qualifications of Educational Personnel with any such States or States joining therein.

title: A bill to extend the authorizations of appropriations in the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 for 1 year, to transfer the Rehabilitation Services Administration to the Office of the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare, to make certain technical and clarifying amendments, and for other purposes; to amend the Randolph-Sheppard Act for the blind; to strengthen the program authorized thereunder; and to provide for the convening of a White House Conference on Handicapped Individuals.
summary: Establishes in the Office of the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare a Rehabilitation Services Administration to carry out this Act.

title: Departments of Labor, and Health, Education, and Welfare Appropriation Act, 1975
Farm Labor Contractor Registration Act Amendments
summary: Removes the limitation on coverage under the Farm Labor Contractor Registration Act to those contractors who transport ten or more migrant workers at any one time.

title: A bill to amend section 2 of title 14, United States Code, to authorize icebreaking operations in foreign waters pursuant to international agreements, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the Coast Guard, pursuant to international agreements, to establish and operate icebreaking facilities on, under, and over waters other than the high seas and waters subject to the jurisdiction of the United States.

title: A bill to extend for 1 year the time for entering into a contract under section 106 of the Water Resources Development Act of 1974.
summary: Extends, under the Water Resources Development Act, for one year the time in which the States of Illinois and Missouri may enter into a contract, either jointly or individually, with the city of Chester, Illinois, for the operation, maintenance, and repair of the Chester Bridge.

title: A bill to provide that Mansfield Lake, Ind., shall be known as "Cecil M. Harden Lake".
summary: Provides that Mansfield Lake, Indiana, shall be known as "Cecil M. Harden Lake".

title: Joint resolution to authorize the continued use of certain lands within the Sequoia National Park by portions of an existing hydroelectric project.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to issue a permit to occupy and use lands of the United States within Sequoia National Park necessary for the continued operation, maintenance, and use of the hydroelectric project known as the Kaweah Numbered 3 project of Southern California Edison Company.

title: Safe Drinking Water Act
A bill to deduct from gross tonnage in determining net tonnage those spaces on board vessels used for waste materials.
An original bill to amend title 10, United States Code, by repealing the requirement that only certain officers with aeronautical ratings may command flying units of the Air Force.
summary: Removes the requirement that only qualified officers with aeronautical ratings may command flying units of the Air Force.

title: Presidential Recordings and Materials Preservation Act
Veterans and Survivors Pension Adjustment Act of 1974
summary: Increases disability and death pensions and dependency and indemnity compensation for veterans and their survivors.

title: Antitrust Procedures and Penalties Act
summary: Provides that any consent decree proposed by the United States must be filed with the court in which the case is pending and simultaneously published in the Federal Register at least sixty days prior to the effective date of the decree.

title: A bill to rescind certain budget authority recommended in the messages of the President of September 20, 1974 (H. Doc. 93-361), October 4, 1974 (H. Doc. 93-365) and November 13, 1974 (H. Doc. 93-387), transmitted pursuant to section 1012 of the Impoundment Control Act of 1974.
A bill to authorize the Secretary of the Interior to purchase property located within the San Carlos Mineral Strip.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to purchase property located within the San Carlos Mineral Strip, taking title to such property in the name of the United States in trust for the San Carlos Apache Indian Tribe.

title: An Act to provide for final settlement of the conflicting rights and interests of the Hopi and Navajo Tribes to and in lands lying within the joint use area of the reservation established by the Executive order of December 16, 1882, and lands lying within the reservation created by the Act of June 14, 1934, and for other purposes.
An Act relating to former Speakers of the House of Representatives.
summary: Extends use of office space, reimburement for office expenses, and the franking privilege to former Speakers of the House of Representatives from two years to as long as they find need therefor.

title: Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act of 1974
A bill to allow advance payment of subscription charges for publications for official use prepared for auditory as well as visual usage.
summary: Allows the advance payment of subscription charges for publications for official U.S. Government use, whether prepared for auditory or visual usage.

title: A bill to establish the Cascade Head Scenic-Research Area in the State of Oregon, and for other purposes.
summary: Establishes the Cascade Head Scenic-Research Area in the State of Oregon.

title: A bill to amend title 44, United States Code, to redesignate the National Historical Publications Commission as the National Historical Publications and Records Commission, to increase the membership of such Commission, and to increase the authorization of appropriations for such Commission.
summary: Redesignates the National Historical Publications Commission as the National Historical Publications and Records Commission.

title: A bill to provide for increased participation by the United States in the Asian Development Bank.
summary: Authorizes the United States Governor of the Asian Development Bank to subscribe on behalf of the United States to 30,000 additional shares of the capital stock in the Bank.

title: Disabled Veterans' and Servicemen's Automobile and Adaptive Equipment Amendments of 1974
summary: Redefines disabled veterans and servicemen eligible for specified assistance in acquiring automobile and adaptive equipment.

title: An Act to grant relief to payees and special indorsees of fraudulently negotiated checks drawn on designated depositaries of the United States by extending the availability of the check forgery insurance fund, and for other purposes.
summary: Extends the availability of the check forgery insurance fund to payees and special indorsees of fraudulently negotiated checks drawn on designated depositories of the United States.

title: A bill to authorize the exchange of certain lands between the Pueblo of Acoma and the Forest Service.
summary: Authorizes the exchange of specified lands between the Pueblo of Acoma and the Secretary of Agriculture.

title: An Act amending the National Housing Act to clarify the authority of the Federal Savings and Loan Insurance Corporation with respect to the insurance of public deposits, and for other purposes.
summary: Revises, under the National Housing Act, the authority of the Federal Savings and Loan Insurance Corporation with respect to the insurance of public deposits.

title: A joint resolution transferring to the State of Alaska certain archives and records in the custody of the National Archives of the United States.

A bill to authorize the Secretary of the Interior to convey, by quitclaim deed, all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to certain lands in Coueur d'Alene, Idaho, in order to eliminate a cloud on the title to such lands.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to convey, by quit-claim deed, all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to specified lands in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, in order to eliminate a cloud on the title to such lands.

title: A bill to amend the act of October 27, 1972, establishing the Golden Gate National Recreation Area in San Francisco and Marin Counties, Calif., and for other purposes.
summary: Revises the boundaries of the Golden Gate National Recreation Area in San Francisco and Marin Counties, California.

title: A bill to provide for crediting service as an aviation midshipman for purposes of retirement for nonregular service under chapter 67 of title 10, United States Code, and for pay purposes under title 37, United States Code.
summary: Provides for crediting service as an aviation midshipman for purposes of pay and retirement for nonregular service in the Armed Forces.

title: To donate certain surplus railway equipment to the Hawaii Chapter of the National Railway Historical Society, Incorporated.
summary: Authorizes the Administrator of General Services to donate all right and title of the United States to specified flatcars and a locomotive to the Hawaii Chapter of the National Railway Historical Society to be used in a park and museum to be built within three years in the State of Hawaii.

title: An Act to amend section 3031 of title 10, United States Code, to increase the number of authorized Deputy Chiefs of Staff for the Army Staff.
summary: Increases the number of authorized Deputy Chiefs of Staff for the Army Staff to four (presently three).

title: A bill to amend section 2634 of title 10, United States Code, relating to the shipment at Government expense of motor vehicles owned by members of the Armed Forces, and to amend chapter 10 of title 37, United States Code, to authorize certain travel and transportation allowances to members of the uniformed services incapacitated by illness.
summary: Expands the conditions under which the shipment of motor vehicles owned by members of the armed forces may be permitted at the expense of the United States.

title: A bill to prevent reductions in pay for any officer or employee who would be adversely affected as a result of implementing Executive Order 11777.
summary: Prohibits the reduction of pay of any officer or employee of the United States by reason of Executive Order 11777, relating to the effective date of the 1972 Federal pay comparability adjustment.

title: An Act to designate certain lands in the Farallon National Wildlife Refuge, California, as wilderness; to add certain lands to the Point Reyes National Seashore; and for other purposes.
summary: Designates various lands in the Farallon National Wildlife Refuge, San Francisco County, California, as wilderness.

title: An Act to amend the act to incorporate Little League Baseball to provide that the league shall be open to girls as well as to boys.
summary: Provides, under the Act to incorporate Little League Baseball, that the league shall be open to girls as well as boys.

title: An Act to authorize certain construction at military installations, and for other purposes.
A joint resolution relative to the convening of the first session of the Ninety-fourth Congress.
summary: Provides that the first session of the Ninety-fourth Congress shall convene at noon on January 14, 1974.

title: Supplemental Appropriations Act, 1975
An Act to provide for the establishment of the Cuyahoga Valley National Recreation Area.
summary: Establishes the Cuyahoga Valley National Recreation Area to preserve the historic, scenic, natural, and recreational values of the area, as well as to provide for the maintenance and use of the lands for recreational purposes.

title: A bill to establish a Commission on Federal Paperwork.
summary: Expresses the findings of Congress, including that Federal information reporting requirements have placed an unprecedented paperwork burden upon private citizens, recipients of Federal assistance, businesses, governmental contractors, and State and local governments.

title: A bill to amend the Act incorporating The American Legion so as to redefine eligibility for membership therein.
summary: Extends the periods of service related to World War II and the Korean War required for membership in the American Legion.

title: A bill to amend title 10, United States Code, to provide that commissioned officers of the Army in regular grades below major may be involuntarily discharged whenever there is a reduction in force.
summary: Provides that commissioned officers of the Army in regular grades below major may be involuntarily discharged whenever there is a reduction in force.

title: Foreign Assistance Act of 1974
summary: Increases the authorization of appropriations to $500,000,000 for food and nutrition for fiscal year 1975.

title: An Act to declare that certain federally owned lands shall be held by the United States in trust for the Hualapai Indian Tribe, of the Hualapai Reservation, Arizona, and for other purposes.
summary: Declares that the interests of the United States in specified lands in the State of Arizona, shall be held by the United States in trust for the Hualapai Indian Tribe, of the Hualapai Reservation, Arizona.

title: Joint resolution to authorize and request the President to issue a proclamation designating January, 1975, as "March of Dimes Birth Defects Prevention Month".
summary: Authorizes and requests the President to proclaim January, 1975, as "March of Dimes Birth Defects Prevention Month."

title: An Act to amend the Admission Act for the State of Idaho to permit that State to exchange public lands, and for other purposes.
summary: Allows Idaho, under its Admission Act, to exchange public lands for other public or private lands.

title: Agriculture-Environmental and Consumer Protection Appropriation Act, 1975
An Act to authorize exchange of lands adjacent to the Teton National Forest in Wyoming, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the exchange of lands adjacent to the Teton National Forest in Wyoming for inclusion in such forest.

title: A bill to remove the cloud on title with respect to certain lands in the State of Nevada.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to issue documents as may be necessary to remove the cloud on title with respect to specified lands in the State of Nevada.

title: A bill to authorize the secretary of the interior to convey to the city of Anchorage, Alaska, interests of the US in certain lands.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to convey to the city of Anchorage, Alaska, interests of the United States in parcels of land described under this Act.

title: Emergency Jobs and Unemployment Assistance Act of 1974
summary: Authorizes appropriation of $2,500,000,000 for fiscal year 1975 to carry out this Act.

title: Joint resolution to authorize and request the President to call a White House Conference on Library and Information Services not later than 1978, and for other purposes.
Veterans Housing Act of 1974
summary: Entitles veterans to a guaranteed, insured, or a direct loan provided any prior GI loan has been paid in full, and the property has been disposed of by the veteran or any immediate veteran-transferee has agreed to the use of his veteran's entitlement.

title: Joint resolution making further continuing appropriations for the fiscal year 1975, and for other purposes.
summary: Makes further continuing appropriations for fiscal year 1975.

title: A bill to authorize military band recordings in support of the American Revolution Bicentennial.
summary: Authorizes the United States Army Band, United States Navy Band, United States Air Force Band, and United States Marine Band to participate in the production of a collection of recordings for commercial sale, in conjunction with the American Revolution Bicentennial.

title: Emergency Unemployment Compensation Act of 1974
summary: Provides that any State may enter into an agreement with the Secretary of Labor under this Act if such State's law contains a requirement that extended compensation be payable thereunder as provided by the Federal-State Extended Unemployment Compensation Act of 1970.

title: An Act to amend title 17 of the United States Code to remove the expiration date for a limited copyright in sound recordings, to increase the criminal penalties for piracy and counterfeiting of sound recordings, to extend the duration of copyright protection in certain cases, to establish a National Commission on New Technological Uses of Copyrighted Works, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides for the elimination of the copyright expiration date of January 1, 1975, for a limited copyright in sound recordings for the purpose of protecting against unauthorized duplication and piracy of sound recordings.

title: An Act to amend the Act of June 9, 1906, entitled "An Act granting land to the city of Albuquerque for public purposes" (34 Stat. 227), as amended.
summary: Grants land to the city of Albuquerque, New Mexico for public park purposes.

title: A bill to authorize the Secretary of the Interior to transfer certain lands in the State of Colorado to the Secretary of Agriculture for inclusion in the boundaries of the Arapaho National Forest, Colo.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to transfer specified lands in the State of Colorado to the Secretary of Agriculture for inclusion in the boundaries of the Arapaho National Forest, Colorado.

title: An Act to amend Public Law 93-276 to increase the authorization for appropriations to the Atomic Energy Commission in accordance with section 261 of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended, and for other purposes.
summary: Increases the authorizations of appropriations to the Atomic Energy Commission (1) from $2,551,533,000 to $2,580,733,000 for operating expenses, and (2) from $208,850,000 to $224,900,000 for capital equipment (not related to construction).

title: Federal Nonnuclear Energy Research and Development Act of 1974
summary: States that it is the policy of the Congress to develop on an urgent basis the technological capabilities to support the broadest range of energy policy options through conservation and use of domestic resources by socially and environmentally acceptable means.

title: A bill to relinquish and disclaim any title to certain lands and to authorize the Secretary of the Interior to convey certain lands situated in Yuma County, Ariz.
summary: Provides that the United States shall relinquish and disclaim any title to specified lands in Arizona.

title: An Act to amend title 5, United States Code, by adding a section 552a, to safeguard individual privacy from the misuse of Federal records, to provide that individuals be granted access to records concerning them which are maintained by Federal agencies, to establish a Privacy Protection Study Commission, and for other purposes.
summary: Prohibits disclosure by Federal agencies of any record contained in a system of records, except pursuant to a written request by or with the prior written consent of the individual to whom the record pertains.

title: Joint resolution to provide for the establishment of the American Indian Policy Review Commission.
summary: Establishes the American Indian Policy Review Commission.

title: An original joint resolution authorizing the Architect of the Capitol to permit certain temporary and permanent construction work on the Capitol grounds in connection with the erection of an addition to a building on privately owned property adjacent to the Capitol grounds.
summary: Authorizes the Architect of the Capitol to permit temporary and permanent construction work on the Capitol Grounds in connection with the erection of an addition to a building on privately owned property adjacent to the Capitol Grounds.

title: A bill to declare that certain land of the United States is held by the United States in trust for the Cheyenne-Arapaho Tribes of Oklahoma.
summary: Declares that specified land of the United States in the State of Oklahoma is held by the United States in trust for the Cheyenne-Arapaho Tribes of Oklahoma.

title: An Act to amend title 18 of the United States Code to permit the transportation, mailing, and broadcasting of advertising, information, and materials concerning lotteries authorized by law and conducted by a State, and for other purposes.
summary: Permits the transportation, mailing, and broadcasting of advertising, information, and materials concerning lotteries authorized by law and conducted by a State.

title: To improve judicial machinery by amending title 28, United States Code, with respect to judicial review of decisions of the Interstate Commerce Commission, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides that the U.S. district courts shall have jurisdiction of any civil action to enforce, enjoin, or suspend, in whole or in part, any order of the Interstate Commerce Commission for the payment of money or the collection of fines, penalties, and forfeitures.

title: A bill to recognize the 50 years of extraordinary and selfless public service of Herbert Hoover, including his many great humanitarian endeavors, his chairmanship of two Commissions of the Organization of the Executive Branch, and his service as 31st President of the United States, and in commemoration of the 100th anniversary of his birth on August 10, 1974, by providing grants to the Hoover Institution on War, Revolution and Peace.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Treasury to make grants to the Hoover Institution on War, Revolution, and Peace in Stanford, California, in order to recognize the fifty years of extraordinary and selfless public service of Herbert Hoover.

title: An Act to amend title 10, United States Code, to provide certain benefits to members of the Coast Guard Reserve, and for other purposes.
A bill to name the Federal building, U.S. Post Office, U.S. courthouse in Brunswick, Ga., as the "Frank M. Scarlett Federal Building".
summary: Names the Federal building, United States post office, United States courthouse, in Brunswick, Georgia, as the "Frank M. Scarlett Federal Building."

title: A bill to convey certain land of the United States to the Inter-Tribal Council, Incorporated, Miami, Oklahoma.
summary: Declares all right, title and interest of the United States to specified Oklahoma land to be held in trust by the United States for various Indian tribes described in this Act.

title: An Act to amend the Act of August 10, 1939 (53 Stat. 1347), and for other purposes.
summary: Provides that any of the Non-Federal lands authorized to be restored to the Umatilla Indian Reservation, Oregon, may be exchanged under the consolidation of national forest lands provisions of Federal law.

title: A bill to authorize the conveyance of certain lands to the United States in trust for the Absentee Shawnee Tribe of Indians of Oklahoma.
An Act to authorize the conveyance of certain lands to the United States in trust for the citizen band of Pottawatomie Indians.
summary: Provides that the duly elected officials of the Citizens Band of Potawatomi Indians of Oklahoma are authorized to convey to the United States in trust for the Citizens Band of Potawatomi Indians of Oklahoma specified lands and the improvements thereon, subject to all valid existing rights.

title: An original bill to extend certain authorizations under the Federal Water Pollution Control Act, as amended, and for other purposes.
summary: Extends specified authorizations under the Federal Water Pollution Control Act through fiscal year 1975.

title: An Act to direct the Administrator of General Services to release certain conditions with respect to certain real property conveyed to the State of Arkansas by the United States, and for other purposes.
An Act to amend section 3(f) of the Federal Property and Administrative Services Act of 1949, with respect to American Samoa, Guam, and the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands.
Federal Rules of Evidence
A bill to amend the Trademark Act of 1946 and title 35 of the United States Code to change the name of the Patent Office to the "Patent and Trademark Office".
summary: Changes the name of the Patent Office to the Patent and Trademark Office under the Trademark Act of 1946.

title: An Act to modify the tax treatment of members of the Armed Forces of the United States and civilian employees who are prisoners of war or missing in action, and for other purposes.
summary: Exempts from the income tax the compensation of members of the Armed Forces during the period of time in which they are hospitalized as a result of disease or injury incurred while serving in a combat zone, for a period of up two years beyond the cessation of combatant activities.

title: A bill to authorize the President to appoint to the active list of the Navy and Marine Corps of certain Reserves and temporary officers.

A bill to amend the Federal Property and Administrative Services Act of 1949 to provide for the disposal of certain excess and surplus Federal property to the Secretary of the Interior for the benefit of any group, band, or tribe of Indians.
summary: Provides for the transfer of certain excess and surplus Federal property to the Secretary of the Interior for the benefit of any group, band, or tribe of Indians which is recognized as eligible for services by the Bureau of Indian Affairs.

title: A bill to amend the Trademark Act to extend the time for filing oppositions, to eliminate the requirement for filing reasons of appeal in the Patent Office, and to provide for awarding attorneys fees.
summary: Extends, under the Trademark Act, time for filing oppositions.

title: An Act to amend title 35, United States Code, "Patents", and for other purposes.

An Act to designate the Veterans' Administration hospital in Columbia, Missouri, as the "Harry S. Truman Memorial Veterans' Hospital"; to amend title 38, United States Code, to increase the rates of vocational rehabilitation, educational assistance and special training allowances paid to certain eligible veterans and persons; and for other purposes.
summary: Directs that the Veterans' Administration Hospital at Columbia, Missouri, shall be designated as the "Harry S. Truman Memorial Veterans' Hospital".

title: An Act designating the lake created by the Hidden Reservoir project, Fresno River, California, as "Hensley Lake".
summary: Revises the Flood Control Act to provide that the lake created by Hidden Reservoir Flood Control Project, Madera County, California be named "Hensley Lake" instead of "Hidden Lake".

title: General Accounting Office Act of 1974
A bill to amend section 510 of the Merchant Marine Act, 1936.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of Commerce, within two years after enactment of this Act, to acquire mariner class vessels in exchange for obsolete vessels in the National Defense Reserve Fleet that are scheduled for scrapping.

title: A bill to amend the act of September 2, 1960, as amended, so as to authorize different minimum grade standards for packages of grapes and plums exported to different destinations.
A bill to increase the borrowing authority of the Panama Canal Company and revise the method of computing interest thereon.
summary: Increases the borrowing capacity of the Panama Canal Company from a limit of $10,000,000 to a limit $40,000,000 and bases the method of computing interest thereon to be utilized by the Secretary of the Treasury on comparable yields of other outstanding obligations of the United States.

title: A bill to discontinue or modify certain reporting requirements of law.
summary: Repeals the requirements of reports from more than one agency on specified subjects.

title: An Act to extend until January 31, 1976 the authority of the National Commission for the Review of Federal and State Laws on Wire-trapping and Electronic Surveillance, and for other purposes.
summary: Extends until January 31, 1976, the time within which the National Commission for the Review of Federal and State Laws on Wiretapping and Electronic Surveillance is authorized to make its report.

title: A bill to expand the authority of the Canal Zone Government to settle claims not cognizable under the Tort Claims Act.
summary: Provides, under the Canal Zone Code, that the Governor, or his designee, may adjust and pay claims for injury to, or loss of, property or personal injury or death arising from the activities of the Canal Zone Government.

title: An Act to amend the Solid Waste Disposal Act to authorize appropriations for fiscal year 1975.
summary: Authorizes appropriations, under the Solid Waste Disposal Act, for fiscal year 1975.

title: A bill to amend the Coastal Zone Management Act of 1972, to provide more flexibility in the allocation of administrative grants to coastal States, and for other purposes.
A bill to establish a working capital fund in the Department of Justice.
An Act to provide a People's Counsel for the Public Service Commission in the District of Columbia, and for other purposes.
summary: Establishes an Office of the People's Counsel within the Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia to represent the people of the District of Columbia in all proceedings related to the rates or services furnished by public utilities under the jurisdiction of the Commission.

title: An Act to amend the act of May 13, 1954, relating to the Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation to provide for a 7-year term of office for the Administrator, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides that there shall be a seven-year term of office for the Administrator of the Saint Lawrence Seaway Development Corporation (presently no limitation on the term of office).

title: An Act to designate a national laboratory as the "Holifield National Laboratory".
summary: Provides that the Oak Ridge National Laboratory at Oak Ridge, Tennessee, shall hereafter be known as the "Holifield National Laboratory".

title: An Act to extend for 2 years the authorizations for the striking of medals in commemoration of the 100th anniversary of the cable car in San Francisco and in commemoration of Jim Thorpe, and for other purposes.
Trade Act of 1974
summary: Authorizes the President for a period of five years to enter into trade agreements with other countries, for the purpose of harmonizing, reducing, or eliminating tariff and nontariff barriers to, and other distortions of, international trade, subject to specified limitations and conditions.

title: Speedy Trial Act of 1974
summary: Provides that in a case involving a defendant, the appropriate judicial officer shall, after consultation with the counsel for the defendant and the attorney for the Government, set a day certain for the trial.

title: Grand Canyon National Park Enlargement Act
summary: Provides for the recognition of the entire Grand Canyon as a natural feature of national and international significance.

title: An Act to amend the Wild and Scenic Rivers Act (82 Stat. 906), as amended, to designate segments of certain rivers for possible inclusion in the national wild and scenic rivers system; to amend the Lower Saint Croix River Act of 1972 (86 Stat. 1174), and for other purposes.
summary: Designates for study specified rivers in California, Michigan, Alabama, Wyoming, Colorado, Minnesota, Tennessee, North Carolina, Connecticut, Illinois, Utah, Oklahoma, Oregon, and Wisconsin as potential additions to the national wild and scenic and rivers system.

title: An Act to further the purposes of the Wilderness Act by designating certain acquired lands for inclusion in the National Wilderness Preservation System, to provide for study of certain additional lands for such inclusion, and for other purposes.
summary: Designates specified lands in Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Kentucky, New Hampshire, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Tennessee, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, and Wisconsin for inclusion in the National Wilderness Preservation System.

title: International Air Transportation Fair Competitive Practices Act of 1974
summary: States that Federal departments and agencies shall take all appropriate actions within their jurisdictions to attempt to eliminate discrimination and unfair competitive practices against United States air carriers in the international air transportation industry.

title: Joint resolution making urgent supplemental appropriations for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1975, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the Tariff Schedules of the United States to permit the importation of upholstery regulators, upholsterer's regulating needles, and upholsterer's pins free of duty.
summary: Allows, under the Tariff Schedules of the United States, the importation of upholstery regulators, upholsterer's regulating needles, and upholsterer's pins free of duty.

title: An Act to establish the Canaveral National Seashore in the State of Florida, and for other purposes.
summary: Establishes the Canaveral National Seashore in Florida, comprising 67,500 acres.

title: Deepwater Port Act of 1974
summary: Provides that no person may engage in the ownership, construction, or operation of a deepwater port except in accordance with a license issued pursuant to this Act.

title: An Act to amend title 10, United States Code, to enable the Naval Sea Cadet Corps and the Young Marines of the Marine Corps League to obtain, to the same extent as the Boy Scouts of America, obsolete and surplus naval material.
summary: Authorizes the Naval Sea Cadet Corps and the Young Marines of the Marine Corps League to obtain obsolete and surplus naval material.

title: Federal Noxious Weed Act of 1974
summary: Permits the Secretary of Agriculture to promulgate such quarantines and regulations requiring inspection of products and articles of any character whatsoever as he deems necessary to prevent the dissemination into the United States of any noxious weeds.

title: An Act to provide for the duty-free entry of a 3.60 meter telescope and associated articles for the use of the Canada-France-Hawaii telescope project at Mauna Kea, Hawaii.
summary: Authorizes and directs the Secretary of the Treasury to admit free of duty imported articles required by the Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope Project to complete the installation on Manna Kea, Hawaii, of an optical telescope of 3.60 meters diameter.

title: An Act designating the Laneport Dam and Lake on the San Gabriel River as the "Granger Dam and Lake".
summary: Changes the name of the Laneport Dam and Lake on the San Gabriel River in Texas to the Granger Dam and Lake.

title: A bill to designate certain lands as wilderness.
summary: Designates specified lands within the National Forest System and the National Wildlife Refuge System as wilderness areas.

title: Transportation Safety Act of 1974
A bill designating San Angelo dam and reservoir on the North Concho River as the "O. C. Fisher Dam and Lake".
summary: Provides for the designation of the San Angelo Dam and Reservoir on the North Concho River in the State of Texas as the O. C. Fisher Dam and Lake.

title: An Act to make technical amendments to the Act of September 3, 1974, relating to salary increases for District of Columbia police, firemen, and teachers, and to the District of Columbia Real Property Tax Revision Act of 1974, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides that District of Columbia policemen and firemen in specified salary classes shall receive, in addition to his or her scheduled rate of compensation stipulated additional compensation.

title: Military Construction Appropriation Act, 1975
Magnuson-Moss Warranty—Federal Trade Commission Improvement Act
summary: Provides that any supplier warranting a consumer product to a consumer in writing shall fully and conspicuously disclose in simple and readily understood language the terms and conditions of such warranty pursuant to any rules issued by the Federal Trade Commission.

title: Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act
summary: Declares that the Congress recognizes a Federal obligation to be responsive to the principle of self-determination through Indian involvement, participation, and direction of educational and service programs.

title: Amendments of 1973 to Federal Law Relating to Explosives
summary: Exempts from Federal law those explosives used solely for sporting, recreational, or cultural purposes in antique firearms or devices.

title: National Arthritis Act of 1974
summary: Directs the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare to establish a National Commission on Arthritis and Related Musculoskeletal Diseases.

title: National Health Planning and Resources Development Act of 1974
Harry S Truman Memorial Scholarship Act
summary: Expresses the findings of Congress and declares that it is especially appropriate to honor former President Harry S. Truman through the creation of a perpetual educational scholarship program to develop increased opportunities for young Americans to prepare and pursue careers in public service.

title: Federal-Aid Highway Amendments of 1074
summary: Authorizes appropriations from the Highway Trust Fund for the Federal-aid primary and secondary systems in rural areas.

title: Headstart, Economic Opportunity, and Community Partnership Act of 1974

A bill to provide for a plan for the preservation, interpretation, development, and use of the historic, cultural, and architectural resources of the Lowell Historic Canal District in Lowell, Mass., and for other purposes.
summary: Establishes a Lowell Historic Canal District Commission to provide for a plan for the preservation, interpretation, development, and use of the historic, cultural, and architectural resources of the Lowell Historic Canal District in Lowell, Massachusetts.

title: Export-Import Bank Amendments of 1974
summary: Adds to the powers of the Export-Import Bank the power to guarantee, insure, coinsure, and reinsure against political and credit risks of loss.

title: Social Services Amendments of 1974
A bill to authorize and direct the Secretary of Agriculture to convey any interest held by the United States in certain property in Jasper County, Ga., to the Jasper County Board of Education.
summary: Directs the Secretary of Agriculture to convey any interest held by the United States in specified property in Jasper County, Georgia, to the Jasper County Board of Education.

title: A bill to amend title 10 of the United States Code in order to clarify when claims must be presented for reimbursement of memorial services expenses in the case of members of the Armed Forces whose remains are not recovered.

An Act to amend the Urban Mass Transportation Act of 1964 to permit financial assistance to be furnished under that Act for the acquisition of certain equipment which may be used for charter service in a manner which does not foreclose private operators from furnishing such service, and for other purposes.
Rehabilitation Act Amendments of 1974
summary: Establishes in the Office of the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare a Rehabilitation Services Administration to be headed by an Administrator appointed by the President with Senate approval.

title: Joint resolution extending the time within which the President may transmit the Budget Message and the Economic Report to the Congress.
summary: Extends until February 3, 1975, the time within which the President may transmit the budget message to the Congress, and extends until February 4, 1975, the time limit to transmit the economic report to the Congress.

title: A bill concerning compensation and other emoluments attached to the Office of the Attorney General.
summary: Restores to the office of the Attorney General the annual rate of basic pay of $60,000.

title: A bill to increase the temporary debt limitation and to extend such temporary limitation until June 30, 1975.
summary: Increases temporarily the public debt limitation set forth in the Second Liberty Bond Act by $131,000,000,000 until June 30, 1975.

title: An Act to suspend increases in the costs of coupons to food stamp recipients as a result of recent administrative actions.
Regional Rail Reorganization Act Amendments of 1975
Joint resolution making further urgent supplemental appropriations for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1975, and for other purposes.
Joint resolution making further continuing appropriations for the fiscal year 1975, and for other purposes.
summary: Makes further continuing appropriations for fiscal year 1975 for specified health, education, and poverty programs.

title: Joint resolution to designate March 21, 1975, as "Earth Day".
summary: Authorizes the President to designate March 21, 1975, as "Earth Day".

title: Joint resolution to amend the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended, and for other purposes.
summary: Extends the Defense Production Act 1950, as amended, for a period of six months.

title: A bill to authorize appropriations for the fiscal year 1975 for certain maritime programs of the Department of Commerce.
Foreign Assistance and Belated Programs Appropriations Act, 1975
Tax Reduction Act of 1975
summary: Provides under the Internal Revenue Code that each individual shall be treated as having made a payment against his payable income tax for his first taxable year beginning in 1974 in an amount equal to 10 percent of the amount of his income tax liability for such taxable year.

title: National Insurance Development Act of 1975
summary: Authorizes a two-year extension, until April 30, 1977, of the federally-assisted riot and crime insurance programs under the National Housing Act.

title: A bill to rescind certain budget authority recommended in the message of the President of November 26, 1974 (H. Doc. 93-398) and as those rescissions are modified by the message of the President of January 30, 1975 (H. Doc. 94-39), and in the communication of the Comptroller General of November 6, 1974 (H. Doc. 93-391), transmitted pursuant to the Impoundment Control Act of 1974.
summary: Approves the President's proposals for budget rescissions of $2,100,000 for the Department of State, of $5,000,000 for the Executive Office of the President, and of $20,022,900 for the General Services Administration for building alterations.

title: A bill to rescind certain budget authority recommended in the message of the President of January 30, 1975 (H. Doc. 94-39) and in the communications of the Comptroller General of February 7, 1975 (H. Doc. 94-46) and of February 14, 1975 (H. Doc. 94-50), transmitted pursuant to the Impoundment Control Act of 1974.
Joint resolution to extend the effective date of certain provisions of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission Act of 1974.
summary: Permits the Commodity Futures Trading Commission to grant provisional designation as a contract market to any boards of trade for any commodities traded thereon for such period not in excess of 90 days from the effective date of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission Act.

title: Joint resolution making an additional appropriation for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1975, for the Veterans' Administration, and for other purposes.
summary: Makes appropriations for fiscal year 1975 of: (1) $638,038,000 for veterans' readjustment benefits; and (2) $500,000 for salaries and expenses of the Federal Election Commission.

title: A bill to authorize supplemental appropriations to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission for fiscal year 1975.
summary: Authorizes supplemental appropriations of $50,200,000 to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission to carry out its functions under the Atomic Energy Act and the Energy Reorganization Act for fiscal year 1975.

title: An Act to amend the joint resolution of July 18, 1939 (53 Stat. 1062), to provide for the acceptance of additional lands for the Home of Franklin D. Roosevelt National Historic Site, and for other purposes.
summary: Permits acceptance by the United States of title to any part of the Hyde Park estate and to any contiguous property located in the town of Hyde Park, New York, which shall be donated for use in connection with any designated governmental function in the administration of such area.

title: A bill to continue the special food service program for children through September 30, 1975.
summary: Provides that the special food service program for children under the National School Lunch Act shall be continued through the summer until September 30, 1975.

title: Joint resolution to authorize and request the President to issue a proclamation designating the calendar week beginning May 12, 1975, as National Historic Preservation Week.
summary: Authorizes the President to issue a proclamation designating the calendar week beginning May 12, 1975, as "National Historic Preservation Week".

title: Travel Expense Amendments Act of 1975
summary: Expands the definition of "employee," for purposes of travel, subsistence and mileage allowances, to include experts and consultants who are intermittently employed by the Federal Government, and those who serve the Government without pay or for $1 a year.

title: The Indochina Migration and Refugee Assistance Act of 1975
summary: Authorizes appropriation of $455,000,000, in addition to amounts otherwise available, for the performance of functions set forth in Migration and Refugee Assistance Act, with respect to aliens who have fled from Cambodia or Vietnam.

title: A bill making appropriations for special assistance to refugees from Cambodia and Vietnam for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1975, and for other purposes.
summary: Makes appropriations to the Department of State and the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare for special assistance to refugees from Cambodia and Vietnam for the fiscal year 1975.

title: Amtrak Improvement Act of 1975
summary: Authorizes the Board of Directors of the National Railroad Passenger Corporation, in its discretion, to approve a salary for the Corporation president of $85,000 or the general level of compensation paid officers of railroads in positions of comparable responsibility, whichever is the lesser.

title: A bill to amend the Organic Act of Guam and the Revised Organic Act of the Virgin Islands.
summary: Provides that the clerk hire allowance and transportation expenses subject to reimbursement under Federal law for the Delegates from Guam and the Virgin Islands to the House of Representatives shall be the same as allowed for Members of the House of Representatives.

title: A bill to amend section 2 of the act of June 30, 1954, as amended, providing for the continuance of civil government for the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands.
summary: Increases the authorization ceiling for fiscal year 1975 for the activities of the civil government of the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands from $60,000,000 to $75,000,000.

title: A bill to continue the special supplemental food program for women, infants, and children through September 30, 1975.
summary: Continues the special supplemental food program created under the Child Nutrition Act of 1966 for women, infants, and children through September 30, 1975.

title: Securities Acts Amendments of 1975
A bill to authorize the increase of the Federal share of certain projects under title 23, United States Code.
summary: Permits up to 100 percent Federal funding for all Federal-aid highway projects (other than Interstate) started by States between February 12 and September 30, 1975.

title: A bill to amend the Grand Canyon National Park Enlargement Act (88 Stat. 2089).
summary: Revises the Grand Canyon National Park Enlargement Act to require the Secretary of the Interior to report his recommendations to the President as to the suitability of any area within the national park for preservation as wilderness.

title: Second Supplemental Appropriations Act, 1976
Joint resolution to honor America.
summary: States that Congress declares the 21 days from Flag Day through Independence Day as a period to honor America.

title: A bill to provide an authorization for an ex gratia payment to the people of Bikini Atoll, in the Marshall Islands of the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands.
summary: Authorizes the appropriation of $3,000,000, ex gratia, in recognition of the hardship suffered by the people of Bikini due to displacement from their atoll since 1946.

title: An Act to amend and extend the Emergency Livestock Credit Act of 1974, and for other purposes.
summary: Directs the extension of financial assistance to bona fide farmers and ranchers who have substantial operations in breeding, raising, fattening, or marketing livestock.

title: Joint resolution making urgent supplemental appropriations for summer youth employment and recreation for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1975, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the appropriation of $473,350,000 for the summer youth employment and recreation program.

title: An Act to authorize United States payments to the United Nations for expenses of the United Nations peacekeeping forces in the Middle East, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes to be appropriated to the Department of State such sums as may be necessary from time to time for payment of the United States share of the expenses of the United Nations peacekeeping forces in the Middle East.

title: A bill to authorize appropriations for the saline water conversion program for fiscal year 1976.
summary: Authorizes $4,100,000 to carry out the provisions of the Saline Water Conversion Act during fiscal year 1976.

title: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Authorization Act, 1976
summary: Authorizes appropriations to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) for research and development, construction of facilities, and for research and program management.

title: Emergency Technical Provisions Act

An Act to amend section 1113 of the Social Security Act to make permanent the program of temporary assistance for United States citizens returned from abroad, subject to specific limitations on the aggregate dollar amount of such assistance which may be provided and on the period for which such assistance may be furnished in any particular case, and for other purposes.

title: A bill to increase the temporary debt limitation until November 15, 1975.

title: A bill to amend title XIX of the Social Security Act to extend the protection against the loss of medicaid because of the 1972 increase in social security benefits, and to extend the exemption of Puerto Rico, Guam, and the Virgin Islands from certain requirements relating to choice of provider.
summary: Stipulates that the 1972 general increase in Social Security benefits shall not be considered in determining eligibility for Medicaid benefits in the case of individuals receiving aid under various public assistance programs and Old-Age, Survivors, and Disability Insurance benefits.

title: A bill to authorize appropriations to carry out the Standard Reference Data Act.
Emergency Housing Act of 1975
An Act to extend the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act, as amended, for three months.

title: A bill to authorize further appropriations for the Office of Environmental Quality, and for other purposes.
