title: An Act to provide that the flag of the United States of America may be flown for twenty-four hours of each day in Valley Forge State Park, Valley Forge, Pennsylvania.
summary: Provides that the flag of the United States of America may be flown for twenty-four hours of each day in Valley Forge State Park, Valley Forge, Pennsylvania.

title: An Act to authorize appropriations for the Coast Guard for the procurement of vessels and aircraft and construction of shore and offshore establishments, to authorize appropriations for bridge alterations, to authorize for the Coast Guard and end-year strength for active duty personnel, to authorize for the Coast Guard average military student loads, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes appropriations to the Coast Guard for fiscal year 1976 and the transition period through September 1976 for procurement of vessels, procurement of aircraft, and construction of shore and offshore establishments.

title: A bill to amend the International Travel Act of 1961 to authorize additional appropriations, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes, under the International Travel Act of 1961, additional appropriations for transition periods in 1976, 1977, 1978, and 1979, to carry out specified programs funded under such Act.

title: Federal Railroad Safety Authorization Act of 1975
A bill to amend section 3620 of the Revised Statutes with respect to certain disbursements to be made by banks, savings banks, savings and loan associations, and credit unions.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Senate and the Clerk of the House, upon request, to draw checks in favor of a financial organizations for the credit of employee's checking accounts, deposit of savings, or purchase of shares.

title: Offshore Shrimp Fisheries Act Amendments of 1975
summary: Provides that not more than 200 vessels with permits shall fish in any quarter of 1975 and not more than 175 in any quarter of 1976, under the Offshore Shrimp Fisheries Act of 1973 pursuant to the agreement with Brazil.

title: Legislative Branch Appropriation Act, 1976

An original joint resolution amending section 5(c) of the Home Owner's Loan Act of 1933 to clarify the authority of Federal savings and loan associations to act as custodians of individual retirement accounts.
summary: Revises section 5(c) of the Home Owners' Loan Act of 1933 to clarify the authority of Federal saving and loan associations to act as custodians of individual retirement accounts.

title: A bill to amend section 301 (b) (7) of the Agricultural Adjustment Act of 1938, as amended, to change the marketing year for wheat from July 1-June 30, to June 1-May 31.
summary: Provides, under the Agricultural Adjustment Act, that the marketing year for wheat shall be changed from July 1-June 30, to June 1-May 31.

title: An Act to amend the Marine Protection, Research, and Sanctuaries Act of 1972 to authorize appropriations to carry out the provisions of such Act for fiscal year 1976 and for the transition period following such fiscal year, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes appropriations for administration of regulation of ocean dumping under the Marine Protection, Research, and Sanctuaries Act, not to exceed $5,300,000 for fiscal year 1976, and not to exceed $1,325,000 for the transition period from July 1, through September 30, 1976.

title: An Act to amend the Public Health Service Act and related health laws to revise and extend the health revenue sharing program, the family planning programs, the community mental health centers program, the program for migrant health centers and community health centers, the National Health Service Corps program, and the programs for assistance for nurse training, and for other purposes.
summary: Directs the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare to make grants to State health and mental health authorities to assist in meeting the costs of providing comprehensive public health services.

title: Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure Amendments Act of 1975
summary: Approves the amendments proposed by the Supreme Court to the Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure which are embraced by the order of that Court on April 22, 1974, except as otherwise provided in this Act, and shall take effect August 1, 1975.

title: A joint resolution to provide for the reappointment of Thomas J. Watson, Jr., as citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
summary: Provides for the reappointment of Thomas J. Watson, Junior, as citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution, when his term expires on June 17, 1975.

title: A joint resolution to provide for the reappointment of Dr. John Nicholas Brown as citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution.
summary: Provides for the reappointment of Doctor John Nicholas Brown as citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution on June 13, 1975.

title: A joint resolution to restore posthumously full rights of citizenship to General R. E. Lee.
summary: Restores posthumously full rights of citizenship to General R. E. Lee, effective June 13, 1865.

title: A bill to amend the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act.

An Act to amend the act of August 16, 1971, as amended, which established the National Advisory Committee on Oceans and Atmosphere, to increase and extend the appropriation authorization thereunder, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes appropriations for the National Advisory Committee on Oceans and Atmosphere (NACOA) as follows: (1) $556,250 for fiscal year 1976 and the transition period through September 1976; and (2) $445,000 for fiscal year 1977.

title: Atlantic Tunas Convention Act of 1975
summary: Allows the President to appoint up to three Commissioners to serve on the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas.

title: Veterans Disability Compensation and Survivor Benefits Act of 1975
summary: Increases the basic rates of service-connected disability compensation to veterans (ranging from 12 percent to 10 percent depending upon the degree of severity of disability).

title: Joint resolution to amend the Defense Production Act of 1950 as amended, to extend the National Commission on Supplies and Shortages.
summary: Revises the Defense Production Act of 1950 to extend the National Commission on Supplies and Shortages for a period of nine months.

title: An Act to amend the Voting Rights Act of 1965 to extend certain provisions for an additional seven years, to make permanent the ban against certain prerequisites to voting, and for other purposes.
A bill to reserve a site for the use of the Smithsonian Institution.
summary: Reserves that portion of the Mall bounded by Third Street, Maryland Avenue, Fourth Street, and Jefferson Drive in the District of Columbia as a site for the future public uses of the Smithsonian Institution.

title: A bill to suspend until the close of October 31, 1975, the duty on catalysts of platinum and carbon used in producing caprolactam.
summary: Suspends until October 31, 1975, the import duty under the U.S. Tariff Schedules on catalysts of platinum and carbon used in producing caprolactam.

title: A bill to suspend the duty on open-top hopper cars exported for repairs or alterations on or before June 30, 1975.
summary: Suspends the rate of duty, under the Tariff Schedules of the United States, on open-top hopper cars exported for repairs or alterations on or before June 30, 1975.

title: A bill to designate the Mountain Park Reservoir, Oklahoma, as the Tom Steed Reservoir.
summary: Designates the Mountain Park Reservoir, Oklahoma, as the Tom Steed Reservoir.

title: Council on Wage and Price Stability Act Amendments of 1975

A bill to authorize appropriations to the Nuclear Regulatory Commission in accordance with section 261 of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended, and section 305 of the Energy Reorganization Act of 1974, and for other purposes.
A bill to authorize the American Indian Policy Review Commission to accept voluntary contributions of services and for other purposes.
summary: Permits the American Indian Policy Review Commission to accept and use voluntary contributions of services, money, and property.

title: An Act to exclude from gross income gains from the condemnation of certain forest lands held in trust for the Klamath Indian Tribe.
summary: Excludes, under the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, from gross income gains from the condemnation of specified forest lands held in trust for the Klamath Indian Tribe.

title: An Act to amend title 39, United States Code, to apply to the United States Postal Service certain provisions of law providing for Federal agency safety programs and responsibilities, to provide for cost-of-living adjustments of Federal executive salaries, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969 in order to clarify the procedures therein with respect to the preparation of environmental impact statements.
A bill to designate the John C. Kluczynski Federal Building.
summary: Designates a Federal office building in Chicago, Illinois, as the "John C. Kluczynski Federal Building."

title: A bill to amend the Merchant Marine Act, 1920, in order to permit cargo vessels to carry more than 16 passengers when emergency situations arise.
summary: Revises the Merchant Marine Act of 1920 to authorize vessels documented under the laws of the United States and not engaged in an international voyage to carry more than 16 persons in addition to crew where an emergency situation has been determined to exist.

title: National Science Foundation Authorization Act, 1976
summary: Authorizes appropriations for the National Science Foundation for fiscal year 1976.

title: An Act to authorize appropriations for carrying out the provisions of the International Economic Policy Act of 1972, as amended, and for other purposes.
summary: States that the staff of the Council on International Economic Policy shall be appointed and compensated without regard to the provisions of law regulating the employment and compensation of persons in the Government service, with specified exceptions.

title: An Act to amend the Tariff Schedules of the United States to provide duty free treatment to watches and watch movements manufactured in any insular possession of the United States if foreign materials do not exceed 70 percent of the total value of such watches and movements, to amend child support provisions of title IV of the Social Security Act, and for other purposes.
An Act to amend the Tariff Schedules of the United States to suspend the duty on certain forms of zinc until the close of June 30, 1978, and for other purposes.
summary: Suspends the rates of duty, under the Tariff Schedules of the United States, on specified forms of zinc for a temporary period until June 30, 1978.

title: A bill to amend the Federal Aviation Act of 1958 relating to war risk insurance.
summary: Provides, under the Federal Aviation Act, that upon the request of the Secretary of Transportation, the Secretary of the Treasury may invest all or any part of the war risk insurance revolving fund in interest-bearing securities of the United States.

An Act to amend the Railroad Unemployment Insurance Act to increase unemployment and sickness benefits, and for other purposes.
A bill to provide that certain unemployment compensation funds may be used for repayable loans to the Virgin Islands.
Education Division and Related Agencies Appropriation Act, 1976
A joint resolution authorizing and requesting the President to issue a proclamation designating Sunday, September 14, 1975, as "National Saint Elizabeth Seton Day".
summary: Authorizes and requests the President to issue a proclamation designating Sunday, September 14, 1975, as "National Saint Elizabeth Seton Day."

title: Joint resolution asking the President of the United States to declare the fourth Saturday of September 1975 as "National Hunting and Fishing Day".
summary: Requests the President to declare the fourth Saturday of September 1975 as "National Hunting and Fishing Day."

title: A bill to redesignate November 11 of each year as Veterans Day and to make such day a legal public holiday.
summary: Designates November 11 (presently the fourth Monday in October) of each year as Veterans Day, to be observed as a legal public holiday beginning in 1978.

title: A bill to authorize the Smithsonian Institution to plan museum support facilities.
summary: Authorizes the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution to plan museum support and depository facilities.

title: Emergency Petroleum Allocation Act of 1975
summary: Extends the provisions of the Emergency Petroleum Allocation Act of 1973 through November 15, 1975.

title: Joint resolution to extend by 2 months the expiration date of the Defense Production Act of 1950 and to extend the funding of the National Commission on Productivity and Work Quality for 2 months.
summary: Extends by two months the expiration date of the Defense Production Act of 1950.

title: An Act to authorize an increase in the monetary authorization for certain comprehensive river basin plans previously approved by the Congress, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes an increase in the monetary authorization for the following comprehensive river basin plans previously approved by the Congress: Arkansas River Basin, Mississippi River and Tributaries, North Branch Susquehanna River Basin, and Santa Ana River Basin.

title: A bill to expend coverage of the Rehabilitation and Betterment Act (Act of October 7, 1949, 63 Stat. 724).
Developmentally Disabled Assistance and Bill of Rights Act
summary: Extends existing authorities under the Developmental Disabilities Services and Facilities Construction Act through fiscal year 1975.

summary: Authorizes appropriations for the Board for International Broadcasting for fiscal year 1976.

summary: Extends, under the Tariff Schedules of the United States, until the close of June 30, 1978 (presently September 30, 1975), the period during which specified dyeing and tanning materials may be imported free of duty.

title: An Act to extend the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act, as amended, for forty-five days.
summary: Authorizes appropriations of $5,983,500 to carry out the provisions of the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act from October 1, 1975 through November 15, 1975.

summary: Provides, under the Federal Rules of Evidence, that a statement is not hearsay if the declarant testifies at the trial or hearing and is subject to cross-examination concerning such statement, and such statement is one of identification of a person made after perceiving him.

title: An Act to declare that certain submarginal land of the United States shall be held in trust for certain Indian tribes and be made a part of the reservations of said Indians, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides that specified submarginal lands purchased by the United States under authority of emergency relief measures of the 1930's and now administered by the Secretary of the Interior for the benefit of specified Indian tribes shall be held by the United States in trust for such tribes.

title: A bill to declare that certain land of the United States is held by the United States in trust for the Pueblo of Laguna.
summary: States that all right, title, and interest of the United States in specified land and improvements thereon are declared to be held by the United States in trust for the Pueblo of Laguna in the State of New Mexico.

title: Department of Housing and Urban Development—Independent Agencies Appropriation Act, 1976
A bill to provide for the striking of medals in commemoration of the Bicentennials of the U.S.  Army, the U.S. Navy and the U.S. Marine Corps.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Treasury to provide for the striking of medals in commemoration of the bicentennials of the United States Army, the United States Navy, and the United States Marine Corps.

summary: Establishes the Japan-United States Friendship Trust Fund, consisting of amounts to be used for the promotion of scholarly, cultural, and artistic activities between Japan and the United States.

summary: Authorizes appropriations of $2,800,000 for fiscal year 1976, $471,000 for the transition period through September 1976, and $3,100,000 for fiscal year 1977, to carry out the nonperforming arts functions of the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts.

title: An Act to suspend the duty on natural graphite until the close of June 30, 1978, and for other purposes.
summary: Suspends, under the Tariff Schedules of the United States, the duty on natural graphite until June 30, 1978.

title: Departments of State, Justice, and Commerce, the Judiciary, and Related Agencies Appropriation Act, 1976

Veterans' Administration Physician and Dentist Pay Comparability Act of 1975

title: An original resolution to extend the authority for the direct purchase of U.S. obligations by Federal Reserve banks.
summary: Extends for one year the authority for the direct purchase of United States obligations by Federal Reserve banks.

title: An Act to amend title 5, United States Code, to correct certain inequities in the crediting of National Guard technician service in connection with civil service retirement, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes full credit for pre-1969 National Guard technician service for annuity computation purposes to those employees who have served under the technician program on or after January, 1969.

title: Maritime Appropriation Authorization Act of 1975
An Act to increase the appropriation authorization relating to the Volunteers in the Parks program, and for other purposes.

summary: Authorizes the Secretary of Agriculture to accept and administer on behalf of the United States gifts or devises of real and personal property for the benefit of the National Arboretum.

summary: Declares it to be the finding of Congress that the rate of productivity growth has declined during four of the past six years in the United States, and that such decline is detrimental to the social and economic welfare of the American people.

title: A bill to designate the new Forest Service laboratory at Auburn, Ala., as the George W. Andrews Forestry Sciences Laboratory.
summary: Provides for the designation of the new Forest Service laboratory at Auburn, Alabama, as the "George W. Andrews Forestry Sciences Laboratory".

An Act to amend section 15d of the Tennessee Valley Authority Act of 1933 to increase the amount of bonds which may be issued by the Tennessee Valley Authority, and for other purposes.

summary: Authorizes appropriations to the Department of State for fiscal year 1976 for administration of foreign affairs.

summary: Extends the provisions of the Education of the Handicapped Act through fiscal year 1977 and authorizes appropriations for such years.

title: New York City Seasonal Financing Act of 1975
summary: Provides that upon written request of the City of New York or a financing agent thereof (authorized by the State of New York), the Secretary of the Treasury may make loans to the city or such agent subject to this Act.

title: A bill to authorize appropriations for the period July 1, 1976 through September 30, 1976.
summary: Authorizes appropriations for the period July 1, 1976, through September 30, 1976, as may be necessary to conduct programs and activities for which funding was authorized on June 30, 1976, provided that this Act shall not affect any other law authorizing appropriations for such period.

title: Consumer Goods Pricing Act of 1975
summary: Repeals the provision of the Sherman Antitrust Act which permits contracts or agreements by the producer or distribution of such commodity prescribing minimum prices for the resale of a commodity bearing a trademark or tradename.

title: A bill to designate the Flat Tops Wilderness, Routt and White River National Forests, in the State of Colorado.
summary: Designates approximately 235,230 acres a the Flat Tops Wilderness in the Routt and White River National Forests, Colorado.

title: A bill to amend section 218 of title 23, United States Code.
summary: Repeals the requirement that the right-of-way for the Alaska Highway be held forever inviolate as a part of such highway for public use.

title: An Act to authorize the Secretary of Agriculture to enter into cooperative agreements which benefit certain Forest Service programs and to advance or reimburse funds to cooperators for work performed, and for other purposes.

title: A bill to authorize the employment of certain foreign citizens on the vessel Seafreeze Atlantic, Official No. 517242.
summary: Allows the owner of the large stern trawler Seafreeze Atlantic to employ for a period of four years foreign citizens as crew members of such vessel for service as fish processors and fishermen.

title: A bill to amend the Act entitled "An Act granting a charter to the General Federation of Women's Clubs."
Defense Production Act Amendments of 1975
summary: Terminates specified titles of the Defense Production Act on September 30, 1977.

title: A bill to amend the effective date of the Defense Production Act Amendments of 1975.
summary: Changes the effective date of the Defense Production Act Amendments of 1975 to November 30, 1975.

summary: Authorizes the Secretary of Agriculture to permit the transfer of unused effective purchaser credit for road construction earned after the date of enactment of this Act from one timber sale to a purchaser to another timber sale to the same purchaser within the same National Forest.

summary: Grants, under the Immigration and Nationality Act, the imigrant status of immediate relative to qualified alien children adopted by an unmarried United States citizens, provided the unmarried citizen is at least 25 years of age.

title: A bill to authorize the Secretary of the Interior to engage in feasibility investigations of certain potential water resource developments.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to engage in feasibility investigations of specified potential water resource developments.

Arts and Artifacts Indemnity Act
Joint resolution making further continuing appropriations for the fiscal year 1976, and for other purposes.

summary: Provides for the establishment of the Father Marquette National Memorial near Saint Ignace, Michigan, pursuant to agreement between the Secretary of the Interior and the Governor of Michigan for the location, construction, design, and operation of such memorial.

summary: Directs the National Commission on the observance of International Women's Year to organize and convene a National Women's Conference.

summary: Establishes the United States Metric Board, composed of 17 members, with a chairman, appointed by the President by and with the advice of the Senate.

title: Veterans and Survivors Pension Interim Adjustment Act of 1975
summary: Provides an average 8 percent increase in the pension rates and $300 increase in the maximum annual income limitation for eligible veterans and their surviving spouses, and eligible children where there is no surviving spouse.

title: A bill to increase the amount of benefits payable to widows of certain former employees of the Lighthouse Service.
summary: Increases by $26 the amount of the benefits payable to widows of qualified former employees of the Lighthouse Service.

title: A bill to amend section 141 of title 13, United States Code, to provide for the transmittal of each of the several States of the tabulation of population of that State obtained in each decennial census and desired for the apportionment or districting of the legislative body or bodies of that State, in accordance with, and subject to the approval of the Secretary of Commerce, a plan and form suggested by that officer or public body having responsibility for legislative apportionment or districting of the State being tabulated.

title: A bill to amend section 2 of the National Housing Act to increase the maximum loan amounts for the purchase of mobile homes.

title: A bill to increase the retired pay of certain members of the former Lighthouse Service.

title: International Security Assistance and Arms Export Control Act of 1976

title: An Act to amend section 815 of the Internal Revenue Code to allow a life insurance company to disregard (for purposes of that section) a distribution during the last month of its taxable year, determined to have been made out of the policyholders surplus account, if such distribution is returned to the company not later than the due date for filing its income tax return (including extensions thereof) for that year, and for other purposes.

title: An Act to increase the temporary debt limit, and for other purposes.

title: A bill to amend section 318 of the Communications Act of 1934, as amended, to enable the Federal Communications Commission to authorize translator broadcast stations to originate limited amounts of local programming, and to authorize FM radio translator stations to operate unattended in the same manner as is now permitted for television broadcast translator stations.

title: A bill to amend title 14, United States Code, to authorize the admission of additional foreign nationals to the Coast Guard Academy.
summary: Increases to 36 (presently 24) the number of slots for the admission of foreign nationals to the United States Coast Guard Academy.

title: Toxic Substances Control Act
A bill to provide cost-of-living adjustments in retirement pay of certain Federal judges.
summary: Provides cost-of-living adjustments in the retirement pay of United States territorial judges.

title: National Science Foundation Authorization Act, 1977
summary: Authorizes the appropriation of $810,700,000 to the National Science Foundation for fiscal year 1977.

title: International Investment Survey Act of 1976
summary: Sets forth Congressional findings with respect to international investment.

title: Joint resolution making continuing appropriations for the fiscal year 1977, and for other purposes.
summary: Makes continuing appropriations for the departments, agencies, and other organizational units of the U.S. Government for fiscal year 1977 for specified programs and activities.

title: Hazardous Materials Transportation Act Amendments of 1976
summary: Authorizes appropriation of $5,000,000 per fiscal year through September 30, 1978 to carry out the provisions of title I (Hazardous Materials Transportation) of the Hazardous Materials Transportation Act.

title: Environmental Research, Development, and Demonstration Authorization Act of 1976
summary: Authorizes appropriations for environmental research, development, and demonstration for fiscal year 1976 and the period between July 1, 1976 and September 30, 1976.

title: A bill to designate the plaza area of the Federal building, Portland, Oreg., the "Terry Schrunk Plaza."
summary: Designates the plaza area of the Federal Building, Portland, Oregon as the "Terry Schrunk Plaza".

title: Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act Amendments of 1976
summary: Authorizes appropriations for carrying out the provisions of the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act and for Federal grants-in-aid under such Act, through fiscal year 1978.

title: An Act to authorize the Secretary of the Department in which the Coast Guard is operating to lease housing facilities for Coast Guard personnel in a foreign country on a multi-year basis.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Department in which the Coast Guard is operating to lease housing facilities for Coast Guard personnel in a foreign country on a multi-year basis.

title: Joint resolution to provide for the appointment of George Washington to the grade of General of the Armies of the United States.
summary: Establishes the grade of General of Armies of the United States which shall have precedence over all other grades of the Army, past and present.

title: Joint resolution authorizing the President to proclaim the week beginning October 3, 1976, and ending October 9, 1976, as National Volunteer Firemen Week.
summary: Authorizes the President to issue a proclamation designating the week beginning October 3, 1976, and ending October 9, 1976, as "National Volunteer Firemen Week."

title: An Act to amend the Independent Safety Board Act of 1974 to authorize additional appropriations, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes to be appropriated to the National Transportation Safety Board $3,800,000 for the fiscal year 1976 transition period; $15,200,000 for fiscal year 1977, and $16,400,000 for fiscal year 1978.

title: Education Amendments of 1976
summary: Amends Title I of the Higher Education Act of 1965 to authorize appropriations of $40,000,000 for each of the fiscal years 1977, 1978, and 1979 for the community service program and the continuing education program.

title: Joint resolution to authorize the erection of the American Legion's Freedom Bell on lands of the park system of the District of Columbia, and for other purposes.
Health Professions Educational Assistance Act of 1976
summary: Amends the Public Health Service Act to extend appropriation authorizations for specified medical training and education programs through fiscal year 1977.

title: An Act to amend the Commercial Fisheries Research and Development Act of 1964 to change certain procedures in order to improve the operation of the programs under such Act and to make the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands eligible to participate in such programs.
summary: Makes the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands eligible, under the Commercial Fisheries Research and Development Act, to participate in Federal programs designed for research and development of the commercial fisheries resources of the United States.

title: An Act to amend the Wild and Scenic Rivers Act, and for other purposes.
summary: Designates a specified segment of the Flathead River, Montana, as a component of the National Wild and Scenic Rivers System. =Title II: Missouri, Montana= - Designates a specified segment of the Missouri River in Montana as a component of the National Wild and Scenic Rivers System.

title: Public Works and Economic Development Act Amendments of 1976
State and Local Fiscal Assistance Amendments of 1976
summary: Allows the use of funds paid to State and local governments, under the State and Local Fiscal Assistance Act of 1972, for nonpriority expenditures and for projects for which the Federal Government will provide additional matching funds.

title: An Act to amend the Service Contract Act of 1965 to provide that all employees, other than bona fide executive, administrative, or professional employees, shall be considered to be service employees for purposes of such act, and for other purposes.
summary: Amends the Service Contract Act of 1965 to redefine "service employees" for purposes of Federal service contract labor standards.

title: National Weather Modification Policy Act of 1976
summary: Directs the Secretary of Commerce to conduct a comprehensive study of the state of scientific knowledge concerning weather modification and weather modification technology.

title: A bill to amend title 38, United States Code, to provide hospital and medical care to certain members of the armed forces of nations allied or associated with the United States in World War I or World War II.
summary: Provides hospital and medical care to members of the armed forces of Poland or Czechoslovakia who participated in armed conflict with an enemy of the United States during World War I or World War II, and who have been citizens of the United States for not less than ten years.

title: A joint resolution authorizing the President to proclaim the week of October 10 through 16, 1976, as "Native American Awareness Week."
summary: Authorizes and directs the President to issue a proclamation designating the week of October 10 through 16, 1976, as "Native American Awareness Week."

title: A joint resolution consenting to an extension and renewal of the Interstate Compact to conserve oil and gas.
summary: Gives congressional consent to an extension through December 31, 1978, of the interstate compact to conserve oil and gas as signed on February 16, 1935, by 29 States.

title: Joint resolution to provide for the convening of the first session of the Ninety-fifth Congress.
summary: Authorizes the first regular session of the Ninety-fifth Congress to begin at 2 o'clock p.m. on Tuesday, January 4, 1977.

title: An Act to authorize the Architect of the Capitol to perform certain work on and maintain the historical sections of the Congressional Cemetery and to study and formulate proposals for renovation and permanent maintenance of such sections by the United States.
summary: Authorizes the Architect of the Capitol to perform such work as may be necessary to prevent further deterioration of historically significant sections of the Congressional Cemetery.

title: An Act to amend title 10, United States Code, to make certain changes in the Survivor Benefit Plan provided for under subchapter II of chapter 73 of title 10, United States Code, and for other purposes.
summary: Revises the Survivor-Benefit Program for retired military personnel by eliminating payments into the Survivor Benefit Program when a beneficiary predeceases the retiree.

title: Joint resolution authorizing the acceptance of the Joint Committee on the Library on behalf of the Congress, from the U.S. Capitol Historical Society, of preliminary design sketches and funds for murals in the first floor corridors in the House wing of the Capitol, and for other purposes.
A bill to designate a Federal building and U.S. Post Office in Jasper, Ga., as the Phil M.  Landrum Federal Building and Post Office.
summary: Designates the Federal building and United States Post Office in Jasper, Georgia, as the Phil M. Landrum Federal Building and Post Office.

title: An Act to revise the appropriation authorization for the Presidential Transition Act of 1963, and for other purposes.
A bill to name the new the new post office in Youngstown, Ohio, the Michael J. Kirwan Post Office.
summary: Designates a new postal facility in Youngstown, Ohio, as the "Michael J. Kirwan Post Office."

title: A bill to designate the "Ray J. Madden Post Office Building."
summary: Designates a specified building in Gary, Indiana, as the Ray J. Madden Post Office Building.

title: Veterans' Education and Employment Assistance Act of 1976
summary: Increases the monthly subsistence allowance payable to disabled veterans.

title: Crime Control Act of 1976
summary: Amends the Omnibus Crime Control and Safe Streets Act of 1968 to establish in the Law Enforcement Assistance Administration the Office of Community Anti-Crime Programs to be under the direction of the Deputy Administrator for Policy Development.

title: Joint resolution to provide that qualified individuals may hear and determine claims for benefits under title IV of the Federal Coal Mine Health and Safety Act of 1969, and to provide for appeal to superior agency authority from any such determination.
summary: Authorizes hearing officers appointed by the Secretary of Labor to conduct hearings involving claims for black lung benefits filed under specified provisions of title IV of the Federal Coal Mine Health and Safety Act of 1969.

title: An Act to authorize conveyance of the interests of the United States in certain lands in Salt Lake County, Utah, to Shriners' Hospitals for Crippled Children, a Colorado corporation.
A bill to designate the Herman T. Schneebeli Federal Building.
summary: Designates the Federal building at West Third Street, Williamsport, Pennyslvania as the Herman T. Schneebeli Building.

title: A bill to designate the "Joe L. Evins Post Office and Federal Building".
summary: Designates a certain public building in Smithville, Tennessee, as the Joe L. Evins Post Office and Federal Building.

title: Supplemental Authorization Act for Military Construction on Guam
A bill to direct the Secretary of the Interior to convey, for fair market value, certain lands to Valley County, Idaho.
summary: Directs the Secretary of the Interior to convey specified lands to Valley County, Idaho, for fair market value.

title: A bill to designate the Federal office building located in Dover, Del., as the "J. Allen Frear Building".
summary: Designates the Federal office building located in Dover, Delaware, as the "J. Allen Frear Building".

title: An Act to exempt from duty certain aircraft components and materials installed in aircraft previously exported from the United States where the aircraft is returned without having been advanced in value or improved in condition while abroad.
A bill to name a portion of the site of the Anthony J. Celebrezze Federal Building in Cleveland, Ohio, the George Washington Square.
summary: Provides for the designation of a portion of the site of the Anthony J. Celebrezze Federal Building in Cleveland, Ohio, as the "George Washington Square".

title: A bill to designate the New Federal Building in Albuquerque, New Mex., as the Senator Dennis Chavez Federal Building.
summary: Provides for the designation of the new Federal building in Albuquerque, New Mexico, as the "Senator Dennis Chavez Federal Building".

title: A bill relating to the deduction of interest on certain corporate indebtedness to acquire stock or assets of another corporation.
An Act to name the Federal office building in Athens, Georgia, the "Robert G. Stephens Jr. Federal Building".
summary: Designates the Federal office building located at 355 East Hancock Avenue, Athens, Georgia, as the Robert G. Stephens, Jr., Federal Building.

title: A bill to name the Federal office in Bluefield, W. Va., the Elizabeth Kee Federal Building.
summary: Names the Federal office building located at 601 Federal Street, Bluefield, West Virginia, the "Elizabeth Kee Federal Building."

title: A bill to amend the Emergency Livestock Credit Act of 1974.
summary: Amends the Emergency Livestock Credit Act to extend the authority of the Secretary of Agriculture to guarantee loans under such Act until September 30, 1978.

title: An Act to authorize the study of certain areas by the Secretaries of Agriculture and the Interior.

An Act to amend the Federal Property and Administrative Services Act of 1949 to permit the donation of Federal surplus personal property to the States and local organizations for public purposes, and for other purposes.

An original bill to amend title 28 of the United States Code to provide that full-time U.S. magistrates shall receive the same compensation as full-time referees in bankruptcy and to adjust the salary of part-time magistrates.
summary: Grants United States magistrates the same compensation as full-time referees in bankruptcy and adjusts the salary of part-time magistrates.

title: An Act to amend title 13, United States Code, to provide for a mid-decade census of population, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of Commerce to furnish, upon written request, authenticated copies of census surveys or reports filed by, or on behalf of, an individual or organization to such individual or organization or to the heir or agent of such individual or organization.

title: An Act to amend the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement Act of 1964 for Certain Employees, as amended, and for other purposes.
summary: Amends the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement Act of 1964 for certain Employees to define terms for purposes of this Act.

title: An Act to extend the provisions of title XII of the Merchant Marine Act, 1936, relating to war risk insurance, for an additional three years, ending September 7, 1978.
summary: Provides that in determining whether to grant insurance or reinsurance to foreign-flag vessels, pursuant to the Merchant Marine Act of 1936, the Secretary of Commerce shall consider the characteristics, the employment, and the general management of the vessel by the owner or charterer.

title: Presidential Protection Assistance Act of 1976
An Act to amend title 18 and title 39 of the United States Code to make parallel the exemption from lottery prohibitions granted to newspapers and to radio and television.
summary: Extends the exemptions provided in Federal law from the prohibition on publication by newspapers of materials relating to lotteries in a State to publication in adjacent States conducting lotteries.

title: A bill to amend the act establishing a code of law for the District of Columbia to prohibit the unauthorized use of a motor vehicle obtained under a written rental or other agreement.
summary: Prohibits the unauthorized use of a motor vehicle obtained under a written rental or other leasing agreement in the District of Columbia.

title: An Act to amend the National Trails System Act (82 Stat. 919), and for other purposes).

An Act to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 to provide for a distribution deduction for certain cemetery perpetual care fund, to modify the effective dates of certain provision of the Tax Reform Act of 1976, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend section 5051 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 (relating to the Federal excise tax on beer).
summary: Provides that the first 60,000 barrels of beer brewed by a brewery in the United States producing less than 2,000,000 barrels annually for consumption shall be taxable under the Internal Revenue Code at a rate of $7 per barrel (as opposed to the flat rate of $9 per barrel presently imposed).

title: An Act to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 to exempt certain aircraft museums from Federal fuel taxes and the Federal tax on the use of civil aircraft, and for other purposes.
summary: Exempts, under the Internal Revenue Code, aircraft museums, as defined in this Act, from Federal taxes on fuel.

title: A bill to amend the Federal Boat Safety Act of 1971.
summary: Amends the Federal Boat Safety Act to declare that until there is a final judicial determination that certain waters in the State of New Hampshire are "navigable waters of the United States," they are declared not to be waters subject to the jurisdiction of the United States.

title: Whale Conservation and Protection Study Act
summary: Directs the Secretary of Commerce, in consultation with the Marine Mammal Commission and the Coastal States, to undertake comprehensive studies of all whales found in waters subject to the jurisdiction of the United States for the purpose of developing measures to conserve and protect such mammals.

title: An Act to amend the District of Columbia Police and Firemen's Salary Act of 1958 to provide for the same cost-of-living adjustments in the basic compensation of officers and members of the United States Park Police force as are given to Federal employees under the General Schedule and to require submittal of a report on the feasibility and desirability of codifying the laws relating to the United States Park Police force.
summary: Stipulates that the compensation of officers and members of the United States Park Police shall be adjusted in accordance with the Federal Civil Service pay comparability system.

title: A bill to amend the act of June 3, 1976, relating to the Commission on Security and Cooperation in Europe.
summary: Establishes the Commission on Security and Cooperation in Europe as a standing committee of the Congress.

title: A bill to extend until November 1, 1983, the existing exemption of the steamboat Delta Queen from certain vessel laws.
summary: Extends until November 1, 1983, the existing exemption of the steamboat Delta Queen from the safety at sea laws.

title: An Act to permit the steamship United States to be used as a floating hotel, and for other purposes.
summary: Permits the steamship United States to be used as a floating hotel.

title: An Act to authorize the obligation and expenditure of funds to implement for fiscal year 1977 the provisions of the Treaty of Friendship and Cooperation between the United States and Spain, signed at Madrid on January 24, 1976, and for other purposes.
An Act to provide that the lake formed by the lock and dam referred to as the "Jones Bluff lock and dam" on the Alabama River, Alabama, shall hereafter be known as the R. E. "Bob" Woodruff Lake.
summary: Designates the lake formed by the Jones Bluff Lock and Dam on the Alabama River in Alabama in honor of R. E. "Bob" Woodruff.

title: An Act to authorize the establishment of the Eugene O'Neill National Historic Site, to provide for a cooperative agreement in the operation of the Cherokee Strip Living Museum and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to accept the donation of, or purchase with funds donated for the acquisition of, the property formerly owned by Eugene O'Neill.

title: A bill to provide for the disposition of funds appropriated to pay a judgment in favor of the Grand River Band of Ottawa Indians in Indian Claims Commission Docket numbered 40-K, and for other purposes.
summary: Provides for the disposition of funds appropriated to pay a judgment in favor or the Grand River Band of Ottawa Indians of Michigan in Indian Claims Commission docket numbered 40-K.

title: An Act to amend the Public Buildings Act of 1959 in order to preserve buildings of historical or architectural significance through their use for Federal public building purposes, and to amend the Act of August 12, 1968, relating to the accessibility of certain buildings to the physically handicapped.

A bill to amend the International Claims Settlement Act of 1949 to provide for the determination of the validity and amounts of claims of nationals of the United States against the German Democratic Republic.
A bill designating Ozark Lock and Dam on the Arkansas River as the "Ozark-Jeta Taylor Lock and Dam."
summary: Designates the Ozark Lock and Dam in Arkansas as the Ozark-Jeta Taylor Lock and Dam.

title: An Act to designate certain lands in the Point Reyes National Seashore, California, as wilderness, amending the Act of September 13, 1962 (76 Stat. 538), as amended (16 U.S.C. 459c-6a), and for other purposes.
summary: Provides for the designation of specified lands in the Point Reyes National Seashore, California, which constitute approximately 25,370 acres as wilderness.

title: An Act to authorize the establishment of the Congaree Swamp National Monument in the State of South Carolina, and for other purposes.
summary: Establishes the Congaree Swamp National Monument in South Carolina.

title: An Act to amend certain laws affecting personnel of the Coast Guard, and for other purposes.
summary: Amends laws relating to the Coast Guard.

title: A bill to amend the Railroad Retirement Act of 1974 with respect to the computation of annuity amounts in certain cases, and for other purposes.
summary: Amends the Railroad Retirement Act of 1974 respecting the computation of annuity benefits for railraod employees and spouses of deceased employees.

title: An Act to extend the boundary of the Tinicum National Environmental Center, and for other purposes.
summary: Revises the area set aside for, and authorizes additions to, the Tinicum National Environmental Center, in the State of Pennsylvania.

title: An Act to amend the act establishing the Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore to provide for the expansion of the lakeshore, and for other purposes.
summary: Expands the boundaries of the Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore.

title: A bill to permit the use of unsworn declarations under penalty of perjury as evidence in Federal proceedings.
summary: Permits the use of unsworn declarations under penalty of perjury as evidence in Federal proceedings wherever, under any law of the United States or any requirement pursuant to law, any matter is required or permitted to be supported by a sworn declaration.

title: A joint resolution to provide for the printing and distribution of the Precedents of the House of Representatives compiled and prepared by Lewis Deschler.
summary: Authorizes the printing of Precedents of the House of Representatives by Louis Deschler as a public document.

title: A bill to amend the Social Security Act to repeal the requirement that a State's plan for medical assistance under title XIX of such act include a provision giving consent of the State to certain suits brought with respect to payment for inpatient hospital services.
An Act for the general revision of the Copyright Law, title 17 of the United States Code, and for other purposes.
summary: Revises title 17, "Copyrights," of the United States Code.

title: Judicial Survivors' Annuities Reform Act
summary: Establishes in the Treasury of the United States a fund to be known as "The Judicial Survivors' Annuities Fund.

title: Rail Transportation Improvement Act
summary: Amends the Rail Passenger Service Act to authorize the appropriation of specified sums for Amtrak for fiscal years 1976 through 1978.

title: An Act to provide for the recognition of the States of Alaska and Hawaii at the Lincoln National Memorial, and for other purposes.
An Act to designate certain lands as wilderness.
A bill to amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act, as amended.
summary: Amends the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to authorize the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to guarantee loans to States and localities for advanced construction of eligible treatment works facilities.

title: The Civil Rights Attorney's Fees Awards Act of 1976
summary: Authorizes the awarding of attorney's fees to the prevailing party (other than the United States) in civil actions to enforce civil rights laws or a provision of the United States Internal Revenue Code.

title: A bill to continue until the close of June 30, 1979, the existing suspension of duties on manganese ore (including ferruginous ore) and related products.
summary: Amends the Tariff Schedules of the United States to suspend for three additional years customs duties on manganese ore (including ferruginous ore) and related products.

title: An Act to upgrade the position of Under Secretary of Agriculture to Deputy Secretary of Agriculture; to provide for an additional Assistant Secretary of Agriculture; to increase the compensation of certain officials of the Department of Agriculture; to provide for an additional member of the Board of Directors, Commodity Credit Corporation; and for other purposes.
summary: Upgrades the position of Under Secretary of Agriculture to Deputy Secretary of Agriculture.

title: Arthritis, Diabetes, and Digestive Disease Amendments of 1976
summary: Directs the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare to establish a National Diabetes Advisory Board to insure the implementation of the long-range plan formulated by the National Commission on Diabetes to combat diabetes.

title: A bill to amend chapter 21 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 and title II of the Social Security Act to provide that the payment of social security taxes by a nonprofit organization with respect to its employees shall constitute (for both tax and benefit purposes) a constructive filing by such organization of the certificate otherwise required to provide social security coverage for such employees if it has not received a refund or credit of such taxes, and to require the filing of such a certificate by any nonprofit organization which paid such taxes but received a refund or credit because it had not previously filed such certificate.
An Act to provide for amendment of the Bretton Woods Agreements Act, and for other purposes.
summary: Amends the Bretton Woods Agreement Act to authorize the United States Governor of the International Monetary Fund to accept specified amendments to the Articles of Agreement of the Fund and to consent to an increase in the United States quota in the Fund.

title: An Act to provide for certain payments to be made to local governments by the Secretary of the Interior based upon the amount of certain public lands within the boundaries of such locality.
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Interior to make payments to units of local government of up to 75 cents per acre for public lands in categories specified in this Act.

title: Unemployment Compensation Amendments of 1976
summary: Extends unemployment insurance coverage to specified agricultural workers, and domestic service workers, and workers performing previously excluded service for nonprofit organizations or for State and local governments.

title: An Act to designate certain lands within units of the national park system as wilderness; to revise the boundaries of certain of those units, and for other purposes.

An Act to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 with respect to the tax treatment of social clubs and certain other membership organizations, to provide for a study of tax incentives for recycling, and for other purposes.
summary: Extends tax-exempt status under the Internal Revenue Code to clubs organized for pleasure, recreation and other nonprofitable purposes, substantially all of the activities of which are for such purposes and no part of the net earnings of which inures to the benefit of any private shareholder.

title: An Act to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 to permit the authorization of means other than stamp on containers of distilled spirits as evidence of tax payment, to provide an extension of certain provisions relating to members of the Armed Forces missing in action, and for other purposes.
summary: Permits under the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 the authorization of means other than a stamp on containers of distilled spirits as evidence of tax payment.

title: Rural Electrification Administration Technical Amendments Act of 1976
summary: Amends the Rural Electrification Act of 1936 to stipulate that the unobligated balance of funds made available for loans by the Rural Electrification Administration shall become part of the Rural Electrification and Telephone Revolving Fund.

title: Immigration and Nationality Act Amendments of 1976
summary: Sets immigration quotas under the Immigration and Nationality Act for aliens from Eastern Hemisphere countries at 45,000 per quarter and 170,000 per year and for aliens from Western Hemisphere countries at 32,000 per quarter and 120,000 per year.

title: A bill to amend title 14, United States Code, to provide for the nondiscriminatory appointment of cadets to the U.S. Coast Guard Academy.
summary: Requires that appointments to the United States Coast Guard Academy be made without regard to the race, sex, color, or religious belief of the applicant.

title: Emergency Medical Services Amendments of 1976
summary: Amends the Public Health Service Act to authorize a second planning grant, or contract to assist an entity in updating its emergency medical services (EMS) plan for the purposes of: (1) expansion and improvement; or (2) improving such services for rural and medically underserved population areas.

title: An Act to amend chapter 7, title 5, United States Code, with respect to procedure for judicial review of certain administrative agency action, and for other purposes.
summary: Abolishes the defense of sovereign immunity with respect to actions in Federal courts seeking relief other than money damages and stating a claim against a Federal administrative agency or officer acting in an official capacity.

title: Federal Records Management Amendments of 197
summary: Declares it to be the purpose of this Act to establish standards and procedures to assure efficient and effective records management.

title: An Act to amend the act of July 9, 1965 (79 Stat. 213; 16 U.S.C. 4601-17(c)), and for other purposes.
summary: Amends the Federal Water Project Recreation Act to authorize the Tennessee Valley Authority to recognize and provide for recreational and other public uses at dams and reservoirs constructed under such authority.

title: A bill to improve judicial machinery by further defining the jurisdiction of U.S. magistrates, and for other purposes.
An Act to provide for increases in appropriation ceilings and boundary changes in certain units of the national park system, and for other purposes.
Federal Land Policy and Management Act of 1976
summary: Declares Congressional policy relating to the use and management of public lands.

title: Resource Conservation and Recovery Act of 1976
summary: Amends the Solid Waste Disposal Act to revise "Title II: Solid Waste Disposal.

title: Veterans Omnibus Health Care Act of 1976
summary: Requires cost studies to determine the actual cost of travel to or from Veterans' Administration health facilities incurred by veterans.

title: United States Grain Standards Act of 1976
Foreign Sovereign Immunities Act of 1976
summary: Grants United States District Courts original jurisdiction, without regard to amount in controversy, of any nonjury civil action against a foreign state as to any claim for relief in person with respect to which the foreign state is not entitled to immunity.

title: An Act to provide for the establishment of constitutions for the Virgin Islands and Guam.
summary: Authorizes the peoples of the Virgin Islands and Guam to organize governments pursuant to constitutions of their own adoption.

title: An Act to amend the Social Security Act with respect to food stamp purchases by welfare recipients.
summary: Amends the Social Security Act to make public assistance Withholding procedures optional (formerly required) for any State plan for aid and services to needy families with children where a recipient household requests that such procedures be utilized.

title: Alaska Natural Gas Transportation Act of 1976
summary: Provides for the suspension, as soon as practicable, of all proceedings pending before the Federal Power Commission on the date of enactment relating to the transportation of Alaskan natural gas.

title: Water Resources Development Act of 1976
National Forest Management Act of 1976
summary: Amends the Forest and Rangeland Renewable Resources Planning Act to direct the Secretary of Agriculture to idenfity and report to Congress annually all lands in the National Forest System which either need to be reforested or are not growing at their best potential rate.

title: A joint resolution authorizing the U.S. Secret Service to continue to furnish protection to certain former Federal officials or members of their immediate families.
summary: Authorizes the United States Secret Service to furnish protection to Federal Government officials and members of their immediate families who have been receiving protection by the Secret Service for a period immediately preceding January 20, 1977.

title: Emergency Natural Gas Act of 1977
summary: Authorizes the President to declare natural gas emergencies where severe natural gas shortages threaten the supply of natural gas for high-priority uses in areas of the United States.

title: Joint resolution making urgent power supplemental appropriations for the Department of the Interior, Southwestern Power Administration for the fiscal year ending September 30, l977, and for other purposes.
summary: Makes appropriations of $6,400,000 for operation and maintenance purposes for fiscal year 1977 to the Southwestern Power Administration in the Department of the Interior.

title: A bill to authorize payment of salaries of certain members of Senate committee staffs at the rates paid to them on January 4, 1977.
summary: Permits specified staff members of a new committee to whom the Committee System Reorganization Amendments of 1977 applies to be paid during the transition period of such committee at the rate which such staff member was paid on January 4, 1977.

title: A joint resolution to extend the period of time in which the American Indian Policy Review Commission must submit its final report and to increase the authorization of appropriations for such Commission.
summary: Extends the American Indian Policy Review Commission's deadline for submitting its final report from six to nine months after the reports of its investigating task forces.

title: Joint resolution to give congressional approval to certain governing international fishery agreements negotiated in accordance with the Fishery Conservation and Management Act of 1976, and for other purposes.
summary: Approves Agreements Concerning Fisheries Off the Coasts of the United States with Bulgaria, Romania, the Republic of China, the German Democratic Republic, the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, and Poland as governing international fishery agreements.

title: A joint resolution extending the filing date of l977 Joint Economic Report.
summary: Extends to March 30, 1977, the filing date of the Joint Economic Committee's report on the President's 1977 Economic Report.

title: A bill to bring certain governing international fishery agreements within the purview of the Fishery Conservation Zone Transition Act.
Joint resolution to authorize a special gold medal to be awarded to Miss Marian Anderson.
summary: Authorizes the President of the United States to recognize Marian Anderson through award of an appropriately designed gold medal.

title: A bill to rescind certain budget authority recommended in the message of the President of September 22, 1976 (H. Doc. 94-620), transmitted pursuant to the Impoundment Control Act of 1974.
summary: Rescinds budget authority for the Bureau of Mines' Helium Fund recommended in H. Doc.

title: An Act to dedicate the canal and towpath of the Chesapeake and Ohio Canal National Historical Park to Justice William O. Douglas, and for other purposes.
summary: Dedicates the canal and towpath of the Chesapeake and Ohio and National Historical Park to Justice William O. Douglas in recognition of his outstanding service as a conservationist and for his efforts to preserve and protect the canal and towpath.

title: A bill to amend the United Nations Participation Act of 1945 to halt the importation of Rhodesian chrome.
summary: Amends the United Nations Participation Act of 1945 to permit enforcement of any executive order restricting the importation of Rhodesian chrome, pursuant to any United Nations Security Council resolution.

title: Joint resolution making an urgent supplemental appropriation for fiscal year ending September 30, 1977, for disaster relief.
summary: Appropriates for fiscal year 1977, $200,000,000 for the President's use for disaster relief to remain available until expended.

title: An Act to amend the Small Business Act and the Small Business Investment Act of 1958.
summary: Amends the Small Business Act to increase the limitation on the amount of loans and other financial assistance made available under the Business Loan and Investment Fund from $6,000,000,000 to $7,400,000,000.

title: A bill to rescind certain budget authority recommended in the message of the President of January 17, 1977 (H. Doc. 95-48), transmitted pursuant to the Impoundment Control Act of 1974.
Joint resolution making further continuing appropriations for the fiscal year 1977, and for other purposes.
summary: Makes further continuing appropriations until April 30, 1977, for the departments, agencies, and other organizational units of the Government for specified programs and activities.

title: Reorganization Act of 1977
summary: Permits the President to prepare and submit to Congress a plan to reorganize any Executive agency for the purpose of improving the functioning of the Executive branch.

title: A bill to provide temporary authorities to the Secretary of the Interior to facilitate emergency actions to mitigate the impacts of the 1976-77 drought.
Emergency Unemployment Compensation Extension Act of 1977
summary: Extends the emergency unemployment compensation program until October 31, 1977.

title: An original bill to amend the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 to increase the amount authorized to be appropriated for the Securities and Exchange Commission for fiscal year 1977.
summary: Amends the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 to increase by $1,500,000 the amount authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 1977 for the Securities and Exchange Commission.

title: An Act to provide for relief and rehabilitation assistance to the victims of the recent earthquakes in Romania.
summary: Amends the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 to authorize appropriations for fiscal year 1977 for relief and rehabilitation assistance to the victims of recent earthquakes in Romania.

summary: Declares all right, title, and interest of the United States in approximately 2,700 acres are being held by the United States in trust for the Paiute-Shoshone Tribes of the Fallon Indian Reservation and Colony, Nevada.

title: An Act to authorize appropriations under the Arms Control and Disarmament Act for the fiscal year 1979, and for other purposes.
summary: Amends the Arms Control and Disarmament Act with respect arms control impact information and analyses required to accompany certain military and weapons legislation or budget proposals.

title: New York City Loan Guarantee Act of 1978
summary: Authorizes the Secretary of the Treasury to guarantee, under stated conditions, the payment of principal and interest on indebtedness of the City of New York.

title: A bill to name a certain Federal building in Laguna Niguel, California, the "Chet Holifield Building".
summary: Designates a specified Federal building in Laguna Niguel, California, as the "Chet Holifield Building."

title: Joint resolution American Indians Religious Freedom
summary: States that it shall be the policy of the United States to protect and preserve for Native Americans their inherent right of freedom to believe, express, and exercise their traditional religions.

title: A bill relating to the disposition of certain recreational demonstration project lands by the State of Oklahoma.

title: An Act to amend the Surface Mining Control and Reclamation Act of 1977 (Public Law 95-87) to raise certain authorized funding levels contained therein, and for other purposes.

title: An Act to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 with respect to the treatment of mutual or cooperative telephone company income from nonmember telephone companies, and for other purposes.
summary: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to provide that income received from nonmember telephone companies shall not be used in determining whether mutual and cooperative telephone companies qualify as tax exempt organizations.

title: A bill to amend the Act incorporating the American Legion so as to redefine eligibility for membership therein.
summary: Amends the charter of the American Legion to entitle those who served in the military or naval services between August 15, 1973, and May 7, 1975, to join such organization.

summary: Authorizes and requests the President to designate October 7, 1978, as "National Guard Day."

title: An Act to authorize appropriations for certain insular areas of the United States, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the appropriation to the Secretary of the Interior of specified sums for grants to the Government of Guam for the construction of public facilities and the maintenance of essential services.

title: A resolution designating July 18, 1979, as "National P.O.W.-M.I.A. Recognition Day".

summary: Deletes the name "American Ephemeris and Nautical Almanac" from the publication put out by the naval Observatory under the direction of the Secretary of the Navy which provides data to navigators and astronomers.

summary: Allows United States nationals, in addition to citizens, to participate in the Junior Reserve Officers' Training Corps.

summary: Provides for the transfer and conveyance: (1) of the silver service of the United States ship Wyoming to the Qyoming State Museum; and (2) of the ship's nameplate and ship's bell to the University of Wyoming.

title: A bill to amend title 39 of the United States Code to provide better enforcement procedures for preventing fraudulent solicitations through the mails.

title: A bill to amend section 2632 of title 10, United States Code, to provide the Secretary of the department in which the Coast Guard is operating with the authority to transport Coast Guard employees to and from certain places of employment.

summary: Permits civil service pension payments made to an employee, Member of Congress, or annuitant to be made to another person if and to the extent expressly provided for in any court decree of divorce, annulment, or legal separation or court ordered property settlement incident to such decree.

title: National Climate Program Act
summary: Establishes a National Climate Program to enable the United States and other nations to understand and respond to natural and man-induced climate processes and their implications.

title: An Act to amend chapter 89 of title 5, United States Code, to establish uniformity in Federal employee health benefits and coverage by preempting certain State or local laws which are inconsistent with such contracts, and for other purposes.
summary: Renders inapplicable any provision of or regulation under State and local law which related to health insurance plans to the extent that such law or regulation is inconsistent with any contractual provision of a Federal employee health benefits plan.

title: International Banking Act of 1978

title: Intelligence and Intelligence-Related Activities Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 1979
summary: Authorizes the appropriation of funds for fiscal year 1979 for the conduct of intelligence and intelligence-related activities of specified agencies in amounts specified in a classified annex to the joint explanatory statement accompanying the Conference Report on this Act.
