summary: Reauthorizes through FY2028 the Congressional Award Board, the board that administers the Congressional Award Program, and modifies program medals.

title: Great Lakes Fishery Research Reauthorization Act
summary: Reauthorizes through FY2030 research and monitoring conducted by the U.S. Geological Survey in support of binational fisheries within the Great Lakes Basin.

title: La Paz County Solar Energy and Job Creation Act
summary: Directs the Department of the Interior, after receiving a request from La Paz County, Arizona, to convey approximately 3,400 acres of identified land managed by the Bureau of Land Management to the county for fair market value.

title: Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act of 2025
summary: Revises requirements for milk provided by the National School Lunch Program of the Department of Agriculture (USDA) to allow schools to offer students whole and reduced-fat milk.

title: Disabled Veterans Housing Support Act
summary: Excludes compensation received for a military service-connected disability from a veteran's income when determining eligibility for assistance under the Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) program.

title: VA Budget Shortfall Accountability Act
summary: Requires the Government Accountability Office (GAO) to review and report on the circumstances and causes of the shortfall in funding of the Veterans Benefits Administration for FY2024 and the expected shortfall in funding of the Veterans Health Administration in FY2025.

title: FAST VETS Act
summary: Establishes conditions under which a veteran's individualized vocational rehabilitation plan (under the Veteran Readiness and Employment program) must be redeveloped.

title: Trafficking Survivors Relief Act
summary: Establishes a process to vacate convictions and expunge arrest records for certain criminal offenses committed by victims of human trafficking that directly result from or relate to having been a trafficking victim.

title: Commerce, Justice, Science; Energy and Water Development; and Interior and Environment Appropriations Act, 2026
summary: Provides FY2026 appropriations to several federal departments and agencies for activities and programs related to commerce, law enforcement, science, energy and water development, public lands, and the environment.

title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026
summary: Provides appropriations to several federal departments and agencies for the remainder of FY2026 and provides continuing FY2026 appropriations for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) through February 13, 2026.

title: Bankruptcy Administration Improvement Act of 2025
summary: Makes several changes to the administration of bankruptcy cases, particularly by increasing amounts received by certain trustees, extending the sunset date of various fees, and extending the term of specified bankruptcy judgeships.

title: Ending Improper Payments to Deceased People Act
summary: This act permanently allows the Department of the Treasury to access certain death records maintained by the Social Security Administration (SSA) to help prevent and recover improper payments (e.g., payments to deceased individuals).

title: Disapproving the action of the District of Columbia Council in approving the D.C. Income and Franchise Tax Conformity and Revision Temporary Amendment Act of 2025.
summary: Reinstates provisions of District of Columbia (DC) tax law to conform with federal tax law.

title: Semiquincentennial Congressional Time Capsule Act
summary: Requires the Architect of the Capitol to create a congressional time capsule in honor of the 250 th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence to be buried in the Capitol Visitor Center on or before July 4, 2026.

title: A bill to waive the 60-day notice requirement for the posthumous honorary promotion of Captain Cody Khork, United States Army.
summary: Allows for the posthumous honorary promotion of Captain Cody Khork to the rank of major in the Army without the required 60-day notice to Congress.

title: To authorize the President to award the Medal of Honor to John W. Ripley for acts of valor during the Vietnam War, and for other purposes.
summary: Authorizes the President to award the Medal of Honor to John W. Ripley for his acts of valor on April 2, 1972, as a member of the Marine Corps during the Vietnam War, for which he was previously awarded the Navy Cross.

title: Holocaust Expropriated Art Recovery Act of 2025
summary: This act permanently extends and expands judicial authority under the Holocaust Expropriated Art Recovery Act of 2016.

title: Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act
summary: Reauthorizes through FY2031 and modifies the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program, the Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) program, and related pilot programs.

title: To amend the FISA Amendments Act of 2008 to extend the authorities of title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 through April 30, 2026, and for other purposes.

Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Public Land Order No. 7917 for Withdrawal of Federal Lands; Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, MN.
summary: Opens approximately 225,504 acres of National Forest System lands in Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties in Minnesota to mineral and geothermal leasing.

title: Homeland Security and Further Additional Continuing Appropriations Act, 2026.
summary: Provides continuing FY2026 appropriations to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) through May 22, 2026.

title: A bill to amend the FISA Amendments Act of 2008 to extend the authorities of title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978, and for other purposes.
summary: Extends the authorities of Title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) until June 12, 2026.

title: Tribal Trust Land Homeownership Act of 2025
summary: Sets forth requirements for the processing of a proposed residential leasehold mortgage, business leasehold mortgage, land mortgage, or right-of-way document by the Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA).

title: Rural Broadband Protection Act of 2025
summary: Requires the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to vet the qualifications of applicants for certain funding programs that support affordable broadband deployment in high-cost areas (e.g., rural communities).

title: A bill to require the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to extend the time period during which licensees are required to commence construction of certain hydropower projects.
summary: Authorizes the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to extend construction deadlines for hydropower projects that were issued a license before March 13, 2020.

title: Sloan Canyon Conservation and Lateral Pipeline Act
summary: Expands the boundaries of the Sloan Canyon National Conservation Area in Clark County, Nevada, and grants rights-of-way through the conservation area and other land administered by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) for the construction of a water transmission pipeline and related facilities.

title: Investing in All of America Act of 2025
summary: Modifies the limit on the amount of financing available to a Small Business Investment Company (SBIC) from the Small Business Administration (SBA).

title: Cape Fox Land Entitlement Finalization Act of 2025
summary: Waives a statutory core township selection requirement for the Cape Fox Corporation and allows Cape Fox to receive other lands to fulfill its remaining land entitlement.

title: Medal of Sacrifice Act
summary: Directs the President to issue a medal of sacrifice for eligible law enforcement officers and first responders who are killed in the line of duty.

title: A bill to amend chapters 83 and 84 of title 5, United States Code, to authorize an increase of the retirement age for members of the Capitol Police.
summary: Authorizes the Capitol Police Board to increase the mandatory retirement age for a member of the Capitol Police to up to age 62 when the board determines such waiver is in the public interest.

title: Gerald E. Connolly Esophageal Cancer Awareness Act of 2025
Fiscal Year 2025 Veterans Affairs Major Medical Facility Authorization Act
summary: Authorizes the Department of Veterans Affairs to carry out a major medical facility project in St. Louis, Missouri, during FY2026.

title: Secure America Act
summary: Provides $70 billion in funding to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), and U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) through FY2029 for immigration enforcement, border security, and related activities.

title: ARTIST Act
summary: Prohibits states from imposing bans on marine mammal products produced by Alaska Natives.

title: Lulu’s Law
summary: Requires the Federal Communications Commission to issue an order explicitly permitting the transmission of wireless emergency alerts to mobile phones in the event of a shark attack.

title: 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act
summary: Establishes and modifies various federal housing programs.

title: Emergency Conservation Program Improvement Act of 2025
summary: Revises the Emergency Conservation Program (ECP) and the Emergency Forest Restoration Program (EFRP) to expand eligibility for payments to agricultural producers and owners of forest land impacted by natural disasters.

title: Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027
summary: Provides continuing FY2027 appropriations for federal agencies and extends various expiring programs and authorities.

title: Hershel ‘Woody' Williams National Medal of Honor Monument Location Act
summary: Requires the authorized monument honoring Medal of Honor recipients to be located within the Reserve (the great cross-axis of the National Mall, which generally extends from the Capitol to the Lincoln Memorial and from the White House to the Jefferson Memorial).

title: To remove restrictions from a parcel of land in Paducah, Kentucky.
summary: Directs the Department of the Interior to remove all deed restrictions from approximately 3.62 acres located at 2956 Park Avenue, on the Paducah Memorial Army Reserve Center in Paducah, Kentucky.

title: Stop Secret Spending Act of 2025
summary: Expands a requirement for federal agencies to report expenditures on the USAspending.gov website to include other transaction agreement expenditures.

title: National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Extension Act
summary: Reauthorizes the National Emergency Medical Services Memorial Foundation to establish in Washington, DC, a monument to commemorate the commitment and service represented by emergency medical services.

title: Doug LaMalfa Federal Disaster Tax Relief Certainty Act
summary: Extends the federal tax deduction for qualified disaster-related personal casualty losses and the exclusion from gross income of qualified wildfire relief payments.

title: LACA
summary: Adds College Station to the list of places where court must be held in the Galveston Division of the Southern District of Texas.

title: Prison Staff Safety Enhancement Act
summary: Establishes requirements for the Department of Justice (DOJ) and component agencies to assess and respond to incidents of sexual harassment and sexual assault by incarcerated individuals against Bureau of Prisons (BOP) staff.

title: Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026
summary: Imposes a variety of sanctions, tariffs, and prohibitions related to Russia, extends an Iran-related sanctions law, and expands a tax deduction for teacher expenses to include early childhood educators.

title: Hydropower Licensing Transparency Act
summary: Directs the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to report annually to Congress on the status of the relicensing process for each application for a renewed hydropower dam license.

title: To reauthorize the Fort Peck Reservation Rural Water System Act of 2000.
summary: Reauthorizes through FY2028 the planning, design, and construction of the Assiniboine and Sioux Rural Water System and the Dry Prairie Rural Water System, both located in Montana.

title: A bill to provide for the equitable settlement of certain Indian land disputes regarding land in Illinois, and for other purposes.
summary: Confers jurisdiction to the U.S. Court of Federal Claims for the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma's land claim arising under the Treaty of Grouseland.

title: A bill to designate the General George C. Marshall House, in the Commonwealth of Virginia, as an affiliated area of the National Park System, and for other purposes.
Modernizing Access to Our Public Oceans Act
summary: Directs the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) to publish geospatial data related to public recreational use of federal waterways (e.g., boating and fishing).

title: A bill to redesignate the National Historic Trails Interpretive Center in Casper, Wyoming, as the "Barbara L. Cubin National Historic Trails Interpretive Center".
summary: Renames the National Historic Trails Interpretive Center located in Casper, Wyoming, as the Barbara L. Cubin National Historic Trails Interpretive Center.

title: Kay Hagan Tick Reauthorization Act
summary: Reauthorizes through FY2030 activities of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to address vector-borne diseases (e.g., diseases spread by bites from ticks or mosquitoes).

title: Improving Social Security’s Service to Victims of Identity Theft Act
summary: Requires the Social Security Administration to provide a single point of contact for any individual whose Social Security account number has been misused.
